name: Sunbeam Family Dairy
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Wisconsin, Sunbeam Family Dairy has been a multi-generational farm since 1942. Known for their small herd of happy Holstein cows, they focus on traditional, hand-crafted dairy products. Their philosophy is 'from pasture to plate, with sunshine in every bite.'

products.name: Sunbeam Cream-Top Yogurt
products.description: Our signature yogurt, rich and velvety with a thick cream layer on top. Perfect for breakfast or as a dessert base. Made using whole milk from pasture-raised cows and live cultures for a tangy, farmhouse taste.

products.name: Cheddar Curds (Squeaky Cheese)
products.description: Fresh, mild cheddar curds known for their delightful squeak. A Wisconsin tradition! Great for snacks or poutine. Made fresh daily for optimal squeakiness.

products.name: Old-Fashioned Chocolate Milk
products.description: A childhood favorite, this creamy chocolate milk is made with real cocoa and our farm’s whole milk. Best served icy cold or as a base for milkshakes.

name: Mighty Roots Organic Vegetables Cooperative
description: This Vermont-based cooperative unites eleven small organic farms, each committed to sustainable, no-till agriculture. They prioritize soil health, biodiversity, and local food security, supplying farm shares and area markets with fresh produce year-round.

products.name: Heirloom Rainbow Carrots
products.description: A medley of purple, orange, and yellow carrots with sweet, earthy flavors and crunchy texture. Gorgeous in salads and roasts, and a favorite among kids for their fun colors.

products.name: Garlic Curls (Spring Garlic Scapes)
products.description: Delicate, garlicky flavor with bright green color. Grill, sauté, or blend into pesto. Available only for a few weeks each spring!

products.name: Celery Hearts, Tender-Cut
products.description: Juicy, crunchy, and perfect for snacking or tossing into soups. Grown with extra care to reduce bitterness.

name: Nuts About You Orchards
description: A quirky, family-run nut orchard in California specializing in tree nuts and quirky nutty products. They’re passionate about biodiversity, and their annual 'Nutty Fest' is a must-see for local foodies. Sustainability is at the core of their processes, with solar-powered irrigation and owl-friendly pest control.

products.name: Roasted California Almonds (Unsalted)
products.description: Crunchy, buttery almonds roasted to perfection. Great as a snack or salad topping. Harvested at peak ripeness for maximum flavor.

products.name: Honey-Glazed Pecan Mix
products.description: Sweet, sticky, and irresistible, this mix features local honey and toasted pecans. Ideal as a gourmet gift or a treat for yourself.

products.name: Hazel-Cocoa Dream Spread
products.description: A decadent chocolate-hazelnut spread, perfect on toast or pancakes. Made with orchard hazelnuts and organic cocoa—treat yourself!

name: The Eggcentric Chicken Collective
description: Based in Oregon’s Willamette Valley, this innovative collective combines heritage chicken breeds, sustainable pasture rotation, and upcycled feed. Their focus is on premium eggs and unique poultry offerings. Their chickens live in mobile coops, and their motto is 'Eggs-actly what you want.'

products.name: Pasture-Raised Large Brown Eggs
products.description: Eggs with deep yellow yolks, laid by happy, free-ranging hens. Excellent for baking or breakfast. Taste the difference fresh air makes!

products.name: Lemon-Herb Egg Salad Kit
products.description: Everything you need (except the bread) for a tangy egg salad—free-range eggs, fresh herbs, and a touch of lemon zest. Pair with your favorite baguette for a quick lunch.

name: Berry Merry Microfarm
description: A tiny but mighty urban microfarm in Toronto’s east end. Specializing in pesticide-free strawberries, raspberries, and other berries, they grow vertically in greenhouses and on sunny rooftops, bringing ultra-fresh fruit to city residents. They’re known for quirky berry puns and surprise-pick events.

products.name: Strawberry Jubilee Basket
products.description: Sweet and juicy hand-picked strawberries, bursting with flavor. Perfect for snacking, shortcake, or muddling into cocktails. Picked at dawn for peak freshness!

products.name: Raspberry Rooftop Jam
products.description: A tart-sweet, seed-packed raspberry jam with a city view. Great on toast or as a cheesecake swirl. Made in small batches for the best flavor.

products.name: Berry Merry Mixed Berry Medley
products.description: A blend of strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries—summer in a box! Excellent for smoothies or decorating cakes. Grown with love and puns.

name: Goatastic Acres
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont, Goatastic Acres has been a family-run goat dairy for three generations. Known for their playful goats and artisanal approach, they focus on small-batch cheeses and yogurts, priding themselves on grass-fed, happy animals and eco-friendly practices. Their philosophy is simple: good cheese starts with good goats.

products.name: Vermont Chèvre Supreme
products.description: A creamy, tangy goat cheese made from 100% pasture-raised goat milk. Perfect for spreading on crackers, crumbling over salads, or elevating a cheese board. Hand-ladled for extra fluffiness.

products.name: Herbed Goat Yogurt
products.description: Thick, tart yogurt infused with a blend of fresh dill, chives, and parsley. Great as a snack, dip, or savory breakfast. Each batch is cultured slowly for maximum flavor.

products.name: Garlic & Chive Goat Cheese Log
products.description: Whipped goat cheese rolled in fresh chives and roasted garlic slivers. Adds a punch of flavor to sandwiches, bagels, or baked potatoes.

name: Barley & Rye Collective
description: A worker-owned cooperative in the Midwest specializing in heirloom grains. They grow barley, rye, and a rotating selection of ancient cereals on regenerative plots, milling their own flours and producing grains for artisan bakers and brewers. Education and biodiversity are at the heart of their mission.

products.name: Heirloom Barley Flour
products.description: Stone-milled from heritage barley varieties, this flour has a nutty flavor and hearty texture. Ideal for rustic breads, pancakes, or craft brewing.

products.name: Red Rye Berries
products.description: Whole, unprocessed rye berries with a rich, malty taste. Perfect for porridge, salads, or home milling. Packed with fiber and nutrients.

products.name: Ancient Grains Hot Cereal Mix
products.description: A blend of barley, rye, and spelt for a nutritious, chewy breakfast. Cooks up creamy with a hint of sweetness and earthy undertones—old-fashioned comfort food.

name: The Quirky Quail Ranch
description: Operating on the outskirts of Portland, The Quirky Quail Ranch is a small, eco-minded farm specializing in heritage quail breeds. Run by a pair of bird enthusiasts, the ranch offers fresh quail eggs, unique feather crafts, and hosts quirky farm tours. Their quirky birds are fed an all-organic diet and roam in spacious, predator-proof aviaries.

products.name: Speckled Quail Eggs
products.description: Tiny, beautiful eggs with a creamy yolk and rich flavor. Favored by chefs for gourmet appetizers or delicate omelettes. Each egg is hand-collected daily.

products.name: Pickled Quail Eggs with Dill
products.description: A tangy, protein-packed snack—quail eggs hard-boiled and marinated in a dill-infused vinegar brine. Perfect for charcuterie boards or adventurous picnics.

name: Rooted in Spuds
description: A third-generation potato farm in Idaho, Rooted in Spuds specializes in unique potato varieties, from purple Peruvians to German Butterballs. Their mission: make everyday eating more colorful and fun, with a focus on soil health and minimal chemical use. They also host an annual 'Spud Fest' with potato games and tastings.

products.name: Purple Peruvian Potatoes
products.description: Eye-catching purple-skinned potatoes with a nutty flavor and creamy texture. Great for roasting, mashing, or making vibrant potato salads. High in antioxidants.

products.name: German Butterball Mashers
products.description: Rich, golden potatoes perfect for the fluffiest mashed potatoes. Their buttery flavor shines with just a pinch of salt and pepper.

name: Harvest Moon Apiary
description: Tucked into the rolling hills of Tennessee, Harvest Moon Apiary is a family-owned operation dedicated to sustainable beekeeping. They produce small-batch honeys, beeswax products, and pollinator-friendly plant seeds. Their bees roam wildflower meadows free from pesticides, and every jar is packed with local floral character.

products.name: Wildflower Raw Honey
products.description: Unfiltered, golden honey with notes of clover, goldenrod, and wild berry. Drizzle on toast, yogurt, or your favorite cheese. Naturally crystallized for a creamy spread.

products.name: Bee Pollen Boost
products.description: A blend of pollen grains collected by the apiary’s bees—bright yellow, sweet, and slightly floral. Stir into smoothies or sprinkle over oatmeal for a nutritional punch.

name: The Cheeky Chickpea Collective
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of eastern Washington, The Cheeky Chickpea Collective is a worker-owned cooperative dedicated to sustainable, organic legume farming. Founded by a group of former city-dwellers with a passion for plant-based cuisine, the collective specializes in heirloom chickpea varieties and other pulses, aiming to satisfy vegans and omnivores alike. Their farming philosophy is rooted in soil regeneration and community engagement, and their quirky sense of humor is reflected in both their product names and their annual Chickpea Festival.

products.name: Sunshine Hummus Spread
products.description: A zesty, creamy hummus made from golden heirloom chickpeas, cold-pressed olive oil, and a hint of sun-dried lemon. Perfect for dipping, spreading, or sneaking by the spoonful!

products.name: Crunchy Chickpea Snackers
products.description: Roasted chickpeas tossed with smoked paprika and rosemary, providing a protein-packed, gluten-free snack that's as addictive as popcorn. Great in lunchboxes or movie nights.

products.name: Cheeky Chickpea Flour
products.description: Finely milled chickpea flour, perfect for gluten-free baking, savory pancakes, or thickening soups and stews. Grown and processed on the farm for maximum freshness.

name: Big Sky Dairy Ranch
description: A sprawling, third-generation family dairy located in Bozeman, Montana, Big Sky Dairy Ranch is famous for its grass-fed Holstein cows and panoramic views of the Rockies. The Johnson family focuses on minimal-intervention, farm-fresh dairy, believing that happy cows produce the creamiest milk. They have recently introduced a few creative dairy products and love hosting school groups for 'Milk-to-Ice Cream' workshops.

products.name: Morning Mist Whole Milk
products.description: Rich, creamy whole milk straight from the pasture-grazed cows. Bottled at sunrise for the freshest taste, it’s perfect for cereals, coffee, or drinking by the glass.

products.name: Montana Dream Cheese Curds
products.description: Squeaky, tangy cheese curds made the old-fashioned way. Enjoyed by locals as a snack or melted on poutine. Each batch is hand-salted and packed at peak freshness.

products.name: Cowboy Vanilla Ice Cream
products.description: Smooth, creamy vanilla ice cream churned with real vanilla beans and whole milk. A Western favorite, especially after a day on the range!

name: Sassy Sprout Urban Farm
description: Located in the heart of downtown Toronto, Sassy Sprout Urban Farm turns rooftops into lush gardens bursting with microgreens, edible flowers, and specialty herbs. Founded by a pair of botanist sisters, the farm is pesticide-free, hydroponic, and focuses on year-round production for restaurants and foodies seeking big flavors from small spaces. Their mission: showing that good things really do come in small (and sassy) packages.

products.name: Rainbow Radish Microgreens
products.description: Peppery, vibrant microgreens that add color and a spicy kick to salads, sandwiches, and sushi rolls. Harvested at the peak of freshness for optimal flavor.

products.name: Sweet Pea Shoots
products.description: Tender, sweet pea shoots with a crisp bite—perfect for tossing into stir-fries or topping avocado toast.

products.name: Edible Flower Confetti
products.description: A cheerful mix of edible nasturtiums, violas, and marigolds. Instantly elevates desserts, cocktails, and cheese boards with color and subtle floral notes.

products.name: Urban Basil Medley
products.description: A fragrant trio of Genovese, Thai, and Purple basil. Grown hydroponically and picked daily for maximum aroma and flavor.

name: Lone Pine Orchard & Ciderworks
description: Overlooking the misty valleys of Vermont, Lone Pine Orchard & Ciderworks is a small but mighty organic apple farm specializing in rare heritage apple varieties and artisanal hard ciders. Owned by a father-daughter duo, the orchard is home to aging apple trees, honeybees, and a loyal sheepdog named Scrumpy. Their philosophy: preserve old-world flavors and foster biodiversity, one apple at a time.

products.name: Scrumpy's Heritage Cider
products.description: A crisp, dry hard cider fermented from a blend of 19th-century apple cultivars. Notes of wildflowers and honey, best enjoyed by a fireplace or bonfire.

products.name: Vermont Apple Butter
products.description: Slow-cooked, spiced apple butter made with a blend of sweet and tart organic apples. Velvety smooth, it tastes like autumn in a jar.

products.name: Crimson Crunch Dried Apples
products.description: Naturally sweet and tart apple rings, air-dried for a chewy, energizing snack. Perfect for hiking, lunchboxes, or trail mix.

name: Bumble & Bean Organic Coffee Farm
description: Perched in the volcanic highlands of Chiapas, Mexico, Bumble & Bean is a small, woman-owned organic coffee farm. They hand-harvest shade-grown arabica beans alongside local honeybee hives, believing that biodiversity supports both rich coffee flavor and healthy pollinators. Their beans are roasted onsite in small batches, and they are as passionate about fair wages as they are about the perfect cup of coffee.

products.name: Highland Honey-Infused Roast
products.description: Medium roast arabica coffee beans infused with subtle notes of wild honey from the farm’s own hives. Balanced and aromatic, this coffee brings a hint of sweetness to your morning ritual.

products.name: Chiapas Sunrise Espresso
products.description: Intense, chocolatey espresso roast, sun-dried on raised beds and roasted to highlight vibrant acidity. Perfect for cappuccinos, lattes, or a bold shot on its own.

products.name: Bumble Bee Pollen Energy Bars
products.description: Handmade energy bars featuring farm-roasted coffee, oats, seeds, and a sprinkle of golden bee pollen. Ideal for a mid-morning boost or a long hike.

name: Maple & More Family Farm
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont, Maple & More Family Farm is a fourth-generation family operation specializing in pure maple syrup and creative maple confections. The Carsons run the farm on sustainable principles, tapping over 1,000 sugar maples each spring and experimenting with new maple-based goodies. Their philosophy is simple: bring the purest taste of the Northeast to your table, with a side of family warmth.

products.name: Classic Vermont Maple Syrup
products.description: Golden, smooth, and intensely aromatic, this syrup is harvested from ancient sugar maples using traditional methods. Perfect for pancakes, oatmeal, or drizzling over vanilla ice cream.

products.name: Maple Sugar Candy
products.description: Melt-in-your-mouth candies made from just one ingredient: pure maple syrup, boiled to perfection and shaped by hand. A unique treat with an intense, natural sweetness.

products.name: Spiced Maple Pecan Spread
products.description: A creamy, spreadable delight blending pure maple syrup and Vermont pecans with a hint of cinnamon. Ideal on toast or waffles, and perfect for holiday gifting.

name: Green Pastures Goat Creamery
description: Located on the windswept plains of Oklahoma, Green Pastures Goat Creamery is a women-owned, certified-organic operation specializing in artisan goat cheeses and yogurts. The herd is pasture-raised and lovingly tended, and the creamery prides itself on gentle, small-batch production and eco-friendly packaging. They're passionate advocates for humane animal care and farm-to-table transparency.

products.name: Oklahoma Chèvre
products.description: A soft, tangy, fresh goat cheese with a creamy texture and a subtle grassy undertone. Delicious crumbled on salads or spread over baguette slices.

products.name: Herbed Goat Milk Yogurt
products.description: Thick, tart yogurt made from 100% goat milk, infused with fresh farm-grown herbs. It’s probiotic-rich and makes a savory breakfast or dip.

products.name: Aged Prairie Goat Cheese Wheel
products.description: A firm, nutty cheese aged for six months, with a golden rind and complex flavor. Slice it for cheese boards or melt into risotto.

name: Sunshine Urban Gardens Cooperative
description: In the heart of downtown Sacramento, this worker-owned urban farm transforms vacant lots into thriving green spaces. Specializing in microgreens, edible flowers, and unusual heirloom vegetables, Sunshine Urban Gardens Cooperative empowers local youth and uses rooftop solar to power their operations. Their mission: make healthy, beautiful food accessible to all city dwellers.

products.name: Rainbow Radish Microgreens
products.description: Peppery, colorful microgreens packed with flavor and nutrition. Sprinkle them on tacos, sandwiches, or avocado toast for a fresh punch.

products.name: Edible Blossom Confetti Mix
products.description: A vibrant blend of edible flowers—nasturtiums, marigolds, borage—that add color and a peppery or sweet zing to salads and desserts.

products.name: Purple Dragon Carrot Bunches
products.description: Gorgeous deep-purple carrots with an orange core, bred from rare heirloom seeds. Sweet and crunchy, excellent for roasting or raw snacking.

name: Riverbend Heritage Wheat Farm
description: A multi-generational farm in Kansas, Riverbend Heritage Wheat Farm is devoted to growing rare heritage grains, especially landrace wheats and barleys. The Schmidts practice regenerative agriculture, rotating crops and letting native prairie grasses thrive alongside their fields. Their flours and grains are beloved by artisanal bakers and brewers nationwide.

products.name: Red Fife Whole Wheat Flour
products.description: Milled from an old Canadian heritage wheat, this flour has a nutty aroma and robust flavor. Perfect for sourdough loaves or hearty pancakes.

products.name: Purple Hull Barley Berries
products.description: Plump, smoky-flavored barley grains with a beautiful purple hue—great in soups, pilafs, or for home brewing.

products.name: Sun-Kissed Spelt Flour
products.description: Stone-ground spelt flour with a slightly sweet, nutty flavor. A favorite for rustic breads and cookies.

name: Feather & Fern Duck Farm
description: Situated near Oregon's coastal forests, Feather & Fern Duck Farm is a quirky, eco-friendly specialty farm raising heritage ducks for eggs, meat, and down. The farm is run by the eccentric but lovable Holtz twins, who are committed to ethical animal husbandry and wetland conservation. Their ducks roam free on ponds and among ferns, producing rich eggs and flavorful meat prized by chefs.

products.name: Heritage Duck Eggs
products.description: Extra-large eggs with creamy yolks and strong shells, perfect for baking or luxurious scrambled eggs. Favored by pastry chefs for their richness.

products.name: Smoked Duck Breast
products.description: Tender, subtly smoky duck breast, cured with Pacific sea salt and alderwood chips. Excellent for charcuterie boards or pasta dishes.

products.name: Downy Duck Feather Pillows
products.description: Exceptionally soft and supportive pillows filled with hand-washed duck down—luxury you can sleep on. Hypoallergenic, but not for those with feather sensitivities!

name: Sunny Acres Sheep Dairy
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont, Sunny Acres Sheep Dairy is a family-run farm dedicated to artisan sheep milk products. For three generations, they've hand-milked their flock and crafted unique cheeses, yogurt, and wool goods. Their philosophy blends time-honored traditions with a commitment to animal welfare and sustainability.

products.name: Sheep's Milk Feta
products.description: A tangy, crumbly cheese made from fresh sheep's milk. Perfect for salads, pizzas, or snacking, its creamy texture and rich flavor reflect the lush pastures of Vermont.

products.name: Cloud Cream Sheep Yogurt
products.description: Ultra-creamy, mild sheep's milk yogurt, loved for its smooth texture and probiotic punch. Delicious with fruit or honey.

products.name: Hand-Spun Sheep Wool Yarn
products.description: Soft, lanolin-rich yarn spun from their own flock—a favorite among knitters for sweaters and scarves.

name: Red River Apiaries
description: Located near the winding Red River of the North, this small, family-run apiary specializes in raw honey, bee pollen, and beeswax products. Committed to pollinator health, they maintain chemical-free hives and work with local farmers to improve habitat.

products.name: Prairie Gold Raw Honey
products.description: Wildflower honey with delicate floral notes, harvested from bees that forage in North Dakota prairies. Unfiltered and unpasteurized for maximum flavor and nutrients.

products.name: Bee Pollen Power Granules
products.description: A crunchy, colorful blend of pollen grains collected by busy bees. Popular in smoothies, yogurt, or as a superfood topping—but not for the severely allergic!

products.name: Beeswax Hand Balm
products.description: Moisturizing balm made from pure beeswax, perfect for gardeners and outdoor workers. Locks in moisture and soothes rough skin.

name: Mirthful Mushroom Cooperative
description: A worker-owned collective based in Oregon's coastal forests, Mirthful Mushroom Cooperative cultivates specialty fungi for chefs and food lovers alike. Their organic, sustainably grown mushrooms are harvested at peak freshness and delivered locally. They believe in fun, fungi, and fair wages!

products.name: Shiitake Supreme Mushrooms
products.description: Fresh, earthy shiitakes with meaty caps and a rich, umami flavor. Fantastic for stir-fries, risottos, or grilling.

products.name: Lion's Mane Noodle Cutlets
products.description: Shredded lion's mane mushrooms, perfect for vegan pulled 'pork' sandwiches or as a protein-packed pasta topper. Tastes like lobster, minus the shellfish risk!

products.name: Mushroom Jerky Bites
products.description: Savory, chewy jerky made from marinated oyster mushrooms—smoky, salty, and totally plant-based. Ideal for snacking on the go.

name: Blueberry Bliss Organic Orchard
description: Tucked away in the Appalachian foothills, Blueberry Bliss Organic Orchard is dedicated to growing the juiciest, sweetest organic blueberries. Family-owned since 1985, they practice regenerative agriculture and invite families for U-Pick adventures every summer.

products.name: Blissful Blueberry Jam
products.description: A thick, spreadable blueberry jam, bursting with sweet-tart flavor. Hand-cooked in small batches and perfect on toast, yogurt, or pancakes.

products.name: Frozen Wild Blueberries
products.description: Individually quick frozen at the peak of ripeness—ideal for smoothies, baking, or a frosty snack straight from the bag.

products.name: Blueberry Syrup Dream
products.description: Deep purple, intensely flavored syrup made from reduced organic blueberries and cane sugar. Pour over pancakes, ice cream, or oatmeal for a morning upgrade.

name: Happy Hens Pastured Eggs
description: Operating on a sun-soaked family farm in California’s Central Valley, Happy Hens Pastured Eggs is known for their happy, healthy chickens who roam free on lush pasture. They are staunch advocates for animal welfare and high-quality, nutrient-rich eggs.

products.name: Golden Sunrise Eggs
products.description: Farm-fresh, pasture-raised eggs with rich orange yolks and sturdy whites—perfect for baking, scrambling, or sunny-side-up breakfasts.

products.name: Pastured Egg Mayonnaise
products.description: Creamy, tangy mayo made with fresh farm eggs and a hint of lemon. Elevates sandwiches, salads, and dips with a rich, homemade taste.

name: Golden Kernel Grainworks
description: Located on the rolling plains of Kansas, Golden Kernel Grainworks is a fifth-generation family farm specializing in heirloom cereals and grains. The Jenkins family is passionate about sustainable farming practices and crop rotation, producing wheat, oats, barley, and a handful of rare grains. They believe in the power of heritage seeds and keeping the soil healthy for future generations.

products.name: Prairie Gold Bread Flour
products.description: High-protein wheat flour milled from hard red winter wheat grown on the Jenkins' fields. Perfect for rustic breads, this flour yields a chewy crumb and rich flavor.

products.name: Heritage Oatmeal
products.description: Stone-milled rolled oats from a rare oat strain, hand-harvested for a nutty flavor and creamy texture in porridge. A breakfast classic.

products.name: Barley Malt Syrup
products.description: Sweet, sticky, and deeply flavorful syrup made from their own barley. Used by artisan bakers and home brewers alike.

name: Nutty by Nature Orchards
description: Nestled in Oregon's Willamette Valley, Nutty by Nature Orchards is a quirky, eco-friendly grove of tree nuts run by three sisters. They champion biodiversity by growing almonds, walnuts, pecans, and hazelnuts, all pollinated by wild bees and geese patrols (for weeds, not nuts). Their nut butters and roasted mixes are famous at local markets.

products.name: Sisterly Spread Almond Butter
products.description: Ultra-creamy almond butter, made in small batches from hand-roasted almonds. Smooth, with just a pinch of sea salt. Spreadable bliss!

products.name: Double Trouble Pecan-Walnut Mix
products.description: A crunchy, toasted mix of pecans and walnuts with a light maple glaze. Perfect for snacking or topping yogurt.

products.name: Hazel Dream Roasted Hazelnuts
products.description: Oven-roasted Oregon hazelnuts—sweet, buttery, and perfect for dessert recipes or nibbling straight from the bag.

name: Veggie Vanguard Urban Coop
description: Founded by a group of passionate city gardeners, Veggie Vanguard Urban Coop transforms vacant lots in Detroit into productive organic vegetable patches. Their mission is to increase food access and foster community through growing unusual and heirloom vegetables, with all profits reinvested into local food education programs.

products.name: Rainbow Beet Medley
products.description: A bundle of heirloom beets in deep red, golden, and candy-striped varieties. Earthy, sweet, and vibrant—great for roasting or salads.

products.name: Spicy Greens Mix
products.description: A lively, peppery mix of arugula, mustard greens, and mizuna. Adds a zesty crunch to any sandwich or salad.

products.name: Heirloom Tomato Quartet
products.description: Four unique tomato varieties, each with its own color and flavor story. Juicy, sweet, and perfect for slicing or sauces.

name: Lucky Fin Fisheries
description: Operating from the rugged coast of Maine, Lucky Fin Fisheries is a family-run, sustainable seafood provider specializing in cold-water fish. They use traditional lines and traps to ensure minimal environmental impact. Their philosophy: keep the ocean healthy, and the fish (and people) will thrive.

products.name: Downeast Haddock Fillets
products.description: Fresh, flaky Atlantic haddock fillets, boneless and skinless. Mild, delicate flavor perfect for chowders or pan-frying.

products.name: Maine Lobster Tails
products.description: Sweet, succulent lobster tails from cold, clean waters. Sustainably harvested and flash-frozen for peak freshness.

products.name: Smoked Mackerel Spread
products.description: Rich, savory spread made from smoked mackerel, cream cheese, and dill. Great on crackers or bagels—an umami-packed treat!

name: Pumpkin Patch & Co.
description: Sprawling across the hills of Vermont, Pumpkin Patch & Co. is a whimsical, family-friendly farm famous for its enormous pumpkins and autumn festivities. They specialize in all things pumpkin, from pies to seeds, and offer hayrides and corn mazes every fall. Their motto: "If it can be pumpkin, we make it!"

products.name: Classic Pumpkin Pie
products.description: Homemade pumpkin pie with a flaky crust and spiced filling. The taste of fall in every bite—perfect for holidays or anytime comfort.

products.name: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
products.description: Crunchy, lightly salted pumpkin seeds, roasted in small batches. A nutritious snack that packs a flavorful crunch.

products.name: Maple Pumpkin Butter
products.description: A velvety spread made from slow-cooked pumpkin, Vermont maple syrup, and warming spices. Delicious on toast, pancakes, or stirred into oatmeal.

name: Udderly Blissful Creamery
description: Udderly Blissful Creamery is a third-generation family-owned dairy farm set among the rolling hills of Wisconsin. Renowned for their commitment to humane animal care and sustainable farming, they specialize in small-batch, artisan dairy products. Their cows are pasture-raised and the farm is powered by renewable energy, making their cheese and yogurts as kind to the planet as they are delicious.

products.name: Sunrise Cheddar Wheel
products.description: Aged for 12 months, this sharp cheddar boasts a nutty flavor and creamy bite. Perfect for cheeseboards or grilled cheese sandwiches. Each wheel is hand-formed and waxed the old-fashioned way.

products.name: Dreamy Cream Yogurt
products.description: Rich, velvety yogurt made from whole milk, lightly sweetened with local wildflower honey. Ideal for breakfast parfaits or smoothies.

products.name: Blissful Blue Cheese
products.description: Crumbly, tangy, and speckled with blue veins, this cheese is matured in the farm's cool aging caves. A decadent addition to salads or gourmet burgers.

name: Feathered Friends Free-Range Farm
description: Located on the sunny outskirts of Asheville, North Carolina, Feathered Friends is a quirky, small-scale poultry collective. The farm is known for its ethical treatment of birds, fun educational tours, and dedication to cage-free, natural egg production. Their birds roam freely, and their colorful eggs are prized by local chefs.

products.name: Rainbow Dozen Eggs
products.description: A vibrant dozen of free-range eggs in hues of blue, brown, and white. Laid by a variety of heritage breed hens; each carton is a surprise! Delicious for breakfast or baking.

products.name: Duck Delight Eggs
products.description: Extra-large, rich duck eggs with creamy yolks, beloved by bakers for making fluffy cakes and pastries.

products.name: Farmyard Feather Duster (Compostable)
products.description: Eco-friendly feather dusters made from naturally-shed chicken feathers, perfect for cleaning delicate items. Good for the earth and your antiques!

name: The Spicy Turnip Collective
description: Based in the heart of New Mexico, The Spicy Turnip Collective is a worker-owned organic farm specializing in root vegetables and fiery peppers. Famed for their experimental crop rotations and commitment to biodiversity, they supply local farmers' markets and hot sauce enthusiasts alike. All crops are grown without synthetic pesticides or herbicides.

products.name: Raging Rio Red Chili
products.description: Bold, medium-hot red chilies with fruity undertones. Fantastic for salsas and stews. Grown in the mineral-rich soils of the Rio Grande valley.

products.name: Twisted Turmeric Turnips
products.description: Golden-fleshed turnips with a spicy kick, infused with a hint of organic turmeric. Perfect roasted or grated raw in salads.

name: Bumble & Blossom Apiaries
description: Nestled among wildflower meadows in Oregon's Willamette Valley, Bumble & Blossom is a boutique apiary run by a pair of former botanists. They specialize in artisanal honeys, bee pollen, and wax products, with a focus on pollinator health and native flora. Their honey is raw, unfiltered, and bursting with the flavors of spring.

products.name: Meadowgold Wildflower Honey
products.description: A golden, floral honey with notes of clover, thistle, and blackberry blossom. Drizzle over yogurt or stir into tea for a fragrant sweetness.

products.name: Buzzworthy Bee Pollen
products.description: Collected from local blooms, this vibrant bee pollen is packed with nutrients and a favorite among health food lovers. Sprinkle on smoothies or salads.

name: Fuzzy Grove Alpaca Ranch
description: Hidden in the foothills of Vermont, Fuzzy Grove is a small, family-run ranch specializing in alpaca fiber, specialty wools, and hand-knit goods. The ranch is renowned for its eco-conscious grazing practices and delightfully soft yarns, perfect for crafters and allergy-conscious customers alike. The resident alpacas are frequent stars of local school field trips.

products.name: Plush Alpaca Yarn (Natural Cream)
products.description: Luxuriously soft, hypoallergenic alpaca yarn in its natural, creamy color. Ideal for knitting baby clothes and winter scarves. Alpaca fiber is known for being gentler on sensitive skin compared to sheep wool.

products.name: Hand-Knit Farm Beanie
products.description: Warm, cozy beanie knit from Fuzzy Grove's own alpaca wool. Each one is unique, showcasing the natural colors of their herd.

name: Golden Row Organic Grains
description: Golden Row Organic Grains is a mid-sized, family-run farm on the rolling prairies of Saskatchewan, Canada. The farm has been certified organic for over a decade, specializing in ancient grains and sustainable crop rotation. Their philosophy centers on soil health and biodiversity, with a focus on supplying health-conscious bakers and small batch brewers across North America.

products.name: Heritage Wheat Berries
products.description: These plump, nutty wheat berries are grown from heritage varieties on chemical-free prairie soil. Perfect for hearty salads, artisan bread baking, or home milling. Grown with meticulous crop rotation for maximum nutrition.

products.name: Stone-Ground Barley Flour
products.description: A wholesome, stone-milled barley flour with a subtle sweetness. Ideal for rustic breads, pancakes, and malted cookies. The gentle milling process preserves nutrients and flavor.

products.name: Buckwheat Pancake Mix
products.description: A gluten-free (but not allergen-free) pancake mix featuring Golden Row's signature buckwheat. Lightly nutty, this mix is popular among health enthusiasts and brunch lovers alike.

name: The Quirky Quail Collective
description: Nestled in the gentle hills of the Loire Valley, France, The Quirky Quail Collective is a worker-owned farm specializing in gourmet quail products. Founded by a group of culinary school friends and bird enthusiasts, their mission is to reintroduce the charm of quail into modern cuisine, while practicing humane and eco-friendly farming.

products.name: Petite Quail Eggs
products.description: Delicate, speckled eggs with a rich, slightly gamey flavor. Perfect for tapas, canapés, and decadent breakfasts. Each egg tells the story of pasture-raised birds and traditional French farming.

products.name: Quail Egg Pasta
products.description: Homemade pasta crafted with fresh quail eggs for a luxurious, silky texture. An elegant upgrade on classic Italian fare, prized by local chefs.

name: Sunny Root Family Farm
description: Sunny Root Family Farm is a small, multi-generational family farm in the Willamette Valley, Oregon. Specializing in root vegetables and heirloom varieties, they are famous at local farmers markets for their vibrantly colored carrots, beets, and potatoes. Their philosophy: 'If it grows underground, we probably grow it!'

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Medley
products.description: A blend of purple, orange, yellow, and white carrots—each variety carefully selected for sweetness and crunch. Great for snacking, roasting, or brightening up salads.

products.name: Heirloom Beet Chips
products.description: Thinly sliced, slow-baked beets with earthy sweetness and a satisfying crunch. A wholesome snack that celebrates the diverse flavors of the valley's soil.

products.name: Golden Potato Mash
products.description: Creamy, buttery mashed potatoes made from Yukon Golds grown in mineral-rich volcanic soil. A comfort food favorite at local restaurants and home kitchens alike.

name: Nuts for You Orchards
description: Tucked amongst California’s Central Valley almond and pecan groves, Nuts for You Orchards is a third-generation specialty nut farm. They believe in sustainable water management and pollinator-friendly practices. Their cheeky name reflects their fun, customer-focused approach to nutty goodness.

products.name: Classic Roasted Almonds
products.description: Hand-selected almonds, dry roasted to a perfect crunch. A protein-packed snack, salad topper, or gourmet gift. Crack open the flavor!

products.name: Chocolate-Dipped Pecans
products.description: Rich, buttery pecans dipped in smooth dark chocolate. A decadent treat balancing earthy, nutty notes with bittersweet cocoa. Irresistible with afternoon coffee.

products.name: Almond Butter Spread
products.description: A creamy, stone-ground almond butter—pure, wholesome, and perfect for spreading on toast or pairing with fresh fruit. Made in small batches for maximum freshness.

name: Great Lakes Fishery Coop
description: Great Lakes Fishery Coop is a sustainable, fishers-owned cooperative based along the shores of Lake Michigan. The Coop unites small family boats, ensuring responsible fishing practices and traceable, fresh-water catch. Their focus is on both classic fillets and innovative preserved fish products that highlight the Great Lakes’ bounty.

products.name: Lake Whitefish Fillets
products.description: Mild, flaky fillets of wild-caught whitefish, sustainably harvested and flash-frozen to preserve freshness. A Midwest classic for grilling, baking, or smoking.

products.name: Smoked Trout Spread
products.description: Rich and savory, this creamy spread is crafted from lightly smoked trout blended with herbs. Perfect on crackers or as a bagel topping—a brunch game-changer!

products.name: Pickled Perch Bites
products.description: Tender perch pieces, pickled in a tangy-sweet brine with a hint of local dill. A nod to Scandinavian lake traditions, ideal for charcuterie boards.

name: Laughing Goat Creamery
description: Nestled in the verdant hills of Vermont, Laughing Goat Creamery is a third-generation family farm specializing in small-batch artisan goat cheeses, yogurts, and butters. The farm is committed to sustainable practices, with goats grazing on rotational pastures and all products made without artificial additives. They are known for their sense of humor, as evidenced by cheese names like 'Bleat Street Blues.'

products.name: Bleat Street Blues Cheese
products.description: A tangy, semi-soft blue cheese made from fresh goat's milk, aged to develop a creamy texture and robust flavor. Perfect for salads, crackers, or melting atop a gourmet burger.

products.name: Vermont Chèvre Spread
products.description: A classic, creamy chèvre with a hint of lemon and herbs, beloved for its spreadability and clean, fresh taste. Great on bagels or roasted vegetables.

products.name: Maple Goat Milk Yogurt
products.description: Luxuriously thick yogurt made with Vermont maple syrup and fresh goat's milk for a tangy-sweet treat. A breakfast favorite or a healthy dessert.

name: Red Tractor Tomato Co-Op
description: Based outside Fresno, California, the Red Tractor Tomato Co-Op is a collective of small growers who united to preserve heirloom tomato varieties. Their focus is on organic, field-ripened tomatoes, processed onsite at the peak of freshness. Known for quirky community events like the 'Tomato Toss.'

products.name: Sunburst Heirloom Tomato Sauce
products.description: A rich, chunky sauce featuring a medley of heirloom tomatoes, slow-simmered with garlic and basil. Fantastic for pasta or homemade pizza night.

products.name: Grandma Rosa’s Sliced Roma Tomatoes
products.description: Perfectly ripe Roma tomatoes, hand-selected and sliced for sandwiches or salads. A nod to the co-op’s Italian heritage and family recipes.

products.name: Spicy Tomato Jam
products.description: A sweet and spicy spread made from overripe tomatoes and chili peppers. Brilliant on grilled cheese or charcuterie boards.

name: The Woolly Wonders Alpaca Ranch
description: High atop the Colorado plateau, The Woolly Wonders Alpaca Ranch raises pedigreed alpacas for fiber, specializing in hypoallergenic, ultra-soft yarn and textiles. Family-run with an open-door policy for visitors, they host 'Alpaca Yoga' every Saturday and believe in animal welfare and environmental stewardship.

products.name: Cloudsoft Alpaca Yarn
products.description: Spun from the fleece of happy, healthy alpacas, this yarn is naturally hypoallergenic, warm, and irresistibly soft. Ideal for luxury scarves and sweaters.

products.name: Alpaca Hiking Socks
products.description: Durable yet cozy socks crafted from 100% alpaca fiber, keeping feet dry and toasty on even the most adventurous hikes.

name: Buzz & Blossom Apiaries
description: Buzz & Blossom Apiaries is a women-owned, urban beekeeping collective in Atlanta, Georgia. Their hives are placed throughout community gardens and rooftops, resulting in honeys with a unique, floral character. The collective invests in pollinator education and local green spaces.

products.name: Peachtree Wildflower Honey
products.description: A golden, aromatic honey with rich notes of clover, violet, and a hint of Atlanta’s famous peach blossoms. Drizzle over toast or stir into tea.

products.name: Honeycomb Snack Squares
products.description: Bite-sized honeycomb pieces dipped in dark chocolate for a sweet, crunchy treat. A natural energy boost with a touch of decadence.

products.name: Bee Pollen Power Mix
products.description: A blend of bee pollen, dried fruit, and seeds for sprinkling on yogurt or smoothie bowls. Packed with protein and antioxidants.

name: Happy Harvest Veggie Patch
description: Located in the outskirts of Madison, Wisconsin, Happy Harvest Veggie Patch is a small, certified-organic producer run by a group of friends passionate about soil health and veggie diversity. Their mission: make vegetables fun, accessible, and delicious for all ages.

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Medley
products.description: An eye-catching mix of purple, yellow, and orange carrots—each variety offering its own sweet, earthy flavor. Perfect for roasting or snacking raw.

products.name: Celery Crunch Stalks
products.description: Crisp, juicy celery stalks picked at peak freshness. Great for lunchboxes, salads, or old-school ants-on-a-log.

products.name: Garlic Greens Pesto
products.description: A bright, punchy pesto made from young garlic greens, basil, and olive oil—no nuts or cheese for a fresh take on a classic. Toss with pasta or use as a sandwich spread.

name: Prairie Gold Grain Collective
description: Nestled in the rolling plains of Kansas, Prairie Gold Grain Collective is a multi-generational cooperative of local wheat and barley growers. Founded in the 1970s during the back-to-the-land movement, the collective champions traditional dryland farming and sustainable crop rotation. Their grains are milled on-site for freshness and flavor, supplying bakeries and home cooks across the Midwest.

products.name: Heirloom Prairie Wheat Flour
products.description: Stone-ground from a blend of heritage wheat varieties, this flour has a nutty flavor and hearty texture. Ideal for sourdough bread, rustic boules, and even cookies that need a wholesome twist. Milled to preserve nutrients and character.

products.name: Barley Gold Rolled Barley
products.description: Chewy, malty, and perfect for soups or breakfast bowls. Prairie Gold's barley is rolled to perfection—just add honey and berries for a hearty Midwest start to your day.

products.name: Sun-Kissed Oat Groats
products.description: Whole oat groats, minimally processed, are perfect for porridge, salads, or homemade granola. Praised by local chefs for their nutty flavor and toothsome texture.

name: Funky Fungi Farmstead
description: Funky Fungi Farmstead is a boutique mushroom farm in the rainy forests of Oregon. Established by a pair of mycologist siblings, the farm specializes in gourmet and medicinal mushrooms grown using organic methods, recycled wood chips, and innovative humidity control. They supply local restaurants and farmer's markets with unique, umami-rich fungi.

products.name: Shiitake Sunshine Caps
products.description: Thick, meaty shiitake mushrooms grown on local oak logs. Their deep umami flavor makes them a star in stir-fries, risottos, or simply sautéed with butter.

products.name: Lion's Mane 'Crab Cake' Mushrooms
products.description: Lion's Mane mushrooms with a mild seafood flavor and stringy texture—perfect for vegan 'crab' cakes. Excellent source of antioxidants and a conversation starter at any dinner table.

products.name: Golden Oyster Rainbow Mix
products.description: A colorful bundle of golden, pink, and blue oyster mushrooms. Mild, nutty, and visually stunning—ideal for creative chefs and veggie lovers.

name: Cluckingham Palace Eggery
description: Cluckingham Palace is a family-run egg farm in upstate New York, known for their pampered heritage hens and whimsical sense of humor. With chickens roaming free in royal coops, their mission is happy hens and healthier eggs. They use non-GMO feed and sustainable practices, and love to host school tours featuring their chicken 'castles.'

products.name: Golden Yolk Royal Eggs
products.description: Large brown eggs with a rich, deep-yellow yolk. Perfect for baking or making fluffy omelets fit for nobility. Each carton is stamped with the royal chicken seal of approval.

products.name: Royal Blue Deviled Eggs
products.description: A party favorite! Hard-boiled eggs filled with a creamy, slightly spicy yolk mix, colored naturally with butterfly pea flowers for a blue twist. Perfect appetizer for your next coronation.

name: The Nutty Squirrel Grove
description: Deep in northern California’s redwood belt, The Nutty Squirrel Grove is a small, organic orchard specializing in tree nuts. Their trees are pollinated by wild bees, and squirrels are frequent, mischievous helpers. The farm is famous for fun nut festivals, educational tours, and delicious, allergen-rich harvests (warning: nut allergies beware!).

products.name: Roasted Royal Walnut Halves
products.description: Freshly roasted walnuts with a hint of sea salt, perfect for snacking, baking, or topping salads. Crunchy, buttery, and addictively good.

products.name: Almond Orchard Butter
products.description: Creamy, stone-ground almond butter made from sun-ripened almonds. Silky smooth, with just a pinch of organic cane sugar. Spread on toast or blend into smoothies.

products.name: Pecan Praline Dream
products.description: Sweet, crunchy pecan pralines made the Southern way, with a hint of vanilla and lots of love. The perfect holiday treat or after-dinner indulgence.

name: Willow & Root Organic Orchard
description: Willow & Root is a picturesque organic orchard on the banks of Michigan's Grand River. They focus on heirloom apples and pears, using biodiverse companion planting and composting instead of synthetic sprays. The farm’s mission is to restore rare fruit varieties and cultivate a love of fresh fruit in their community.

products.name: Heirloom Cider Apples
products.description: A tart, aromatic blend of antique apple varieties, grown for their complex flavors. Excellent for cider-making or old-fashioned apple pie.

products.name: Sunset Bosc Pears
products.description: Golden-skinned Bosc pears, picked at the peak of ripeness. Sweet, floral, and perfect for cheese boards or caramelizing in tarts. Local legend says the trees were a wedding gift in 1923.

products.name: Apple Blossom Honeycrisp Chips
products.description: Crispy, sweet, air-dried apple chips made from their prized Honeycrisp apples. A portable, healthy snack for lunchboxes and hikers.

name: Sunset Valley Goat Dairy
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of upstate Vermont, Sunset Valley Goat Dairy is a small, family-owned farm specializing in artisanal goat milk products. The farm has been in the Parker family for three generations and is renowned for its sustainable practices and happy, pasture-raised goats. They believe that happy goats make the best milk, and their philosophy is rooted in respect for animals, land, and community.

products.name: Creamy Chèvre Delight
products.description: A tangy, spreadable fresh goat cheese with a velvety texture and subtle notes of wild herbs from the surrounding meadows. Perfect for crackers or melting over roasted veggies.

products.name: Maple Goat Milk Yogurt
products.description: Rich, smooth yogurt made from fresh goat milk and local Vermont maple syrup. A breakfast treat or creamy dessert that strikes the perfect balance between tart and sweet.

products.name: Goat’s Milk Feta Cubes
products.description: Salty, crumbly feta with a distinctive tang, aged in brine and perfect for tossing into salads or stuffing into peppers. A Greek-inspired favorite made with Vermont flair.

name: Blue Sky Aquaponics Cooperative
description: Located in the heart of Oregon’s Willamette Valley, Blue Sky Aquaponics Cooperative is an innovative producer combining fish farming and hydroponic vegetable growing. The coop is member-owned and committed to ultra-fresh, chemical-free produce and responsibly raised fish. Their closed-loop system recycles nutrients and water, making them a sustainability leader.

products.name: Rainbow Trout Fillets
products.description: Mild, tender, and sustainably farmed rainbow trout fillets. Great for grilling or pan-searing, and a favorite among local chefs for their clean flavor.

products.name: Living Basil Bunches
products.description: Hydroponically grown basil, roots and all, for exceptional freshness and aroma. Snip as needed for a burst of flavor in salads, pastas, or cocktails.

products.name: Butter Lettuce Heads
products.description: Tender, buttery lettuce with a melt-in-your-mouth texture. Grown in nutrient-rich aquaponic beds for a sweet, mild taste. Perfect for wraps or salads.

name: Starlight Berry Patch
description: A picturesque, woman-owned berry farm in eastern Washington, Starlight Berry Patch specializes in organic, sun-ripened strawberries and blueberries. Founded by the Carter sisters, the farm is known for its vibrant, kid-friendly u-pick events and eco-conscious farming methods. They believe in sharing the joys of fresh fruit with families near and far.

products.name: Sun-Kissed Strawberries
products.description: Bright red, juicy strawberries picked at peak ripeness. Sweet and fragrant, these berries are perfect for snacking, baking, or topping your morning cereal.

products.name: Blueberry Bliss Jams
products.description: Small-batch jam bursting with the flavor of handpicked blueberries. Made with a hint of lemon zest for a tart, refreshing finish. Ideal on toast or swirled into yogurt.

name: Fieldstone Heritage Cattle Ranch
description: Fieldstone Heritage Cattle Ranch is a fifth-generation family ranch in Nebraska, devoted to raising heritage breed cattle and producing premium, grass-fed beef. The ranchers pride themselves on animal welfare, open pastures, and regenerative grazing techniques that restore prairie ecosystems. Their beef is a favorite at local farmers’ markets and high-end restaurants alike.

products.name: Prairie Prime Ribeye Steaks
products.description: Thick-cut, marbled ribeye steaks from heritage breed cattle. Tender and intensely flavorful, these steaks are dry-aged for 21 days for maximum taste.

products.name: Grass-Fed Beef Jerky
products.description: Savory, chewy jerky seasoned with black pepper and garlic. Made from grass-fed beef, it’s a protein-rich snack for the trail or office.

name: Sunflower & Sage Veg Collective
description: Situated on the outskirts of Austin, Texas, Sunflower & Sage Veg Collective is an urban, worker-owned organic vegetable farm specializing in unique sunflowers and Southern greens. The collective is passionate about biodiversity, heirloom varieties, and community-supported agriculture. Their fields are as colorful as their weekly farmers’ market stand.

products.name: Heirloom Sunflower Seeds
products.description: Crunchy, nutty sunflower seeds roasted to perfection. A healthy snack or salad topper, these seeds are a staple for local foodies.

products.name: Zesty Collard Greens Bunch
products.description: Fresh, robust collard greens picked early in the morning. Ideal for braising, adding to stews, or using as a wrap for a nutrient-dense lunch.

products.name: Rainbow Beet Chips
products.description: Crispy, colorful beet chips made from heirloom varieties. Lightly salted and oven-baked for a guilt-free crunch.

name: Whistling Fields Free-Range Eggery
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Wisconsin, Whistling Fields is a family-run egg farm with a passion for happy, healthy hens. Founded by the Garrison family in the 1980s, they prioritize animal welfare, pasture-raised methods, and environmental stewardship. Their hens roam on green grass, pecking at bugs and basking in sunlight, resulting in deeply flavorful eggs. Whistling Fields focuses on both chicken and duck eggs, offering premium options to foodies and local restaurants.

products.name: Sunrise Yolks Jumbo Chicken Eggs
products.description: Bright golden yolks and firm whites—these jumbo eggs come from pasture-raised hens and are perfect for everything from breakfast scrambles to classic baking.

products.name: Speckled Duck Eggs
products.description: Larger and richer than chicken eggs with a creamy texture and impressive baking qualities. Duck eggs are prized by pastry chefs for their higher protein content.

name: Grandpa Elmo’s Heirloom Orchard
description: Located in the Shenandoah Valley, Grandpa Elmo’s has been family-owned for four generations. They specialize in rare and heritage apple varieties, hand-cultivated for flavor and nostalgia. Their motto: ‘Old Trees, New Memories.’ They also experiment with small-batch ciders and seasonal preserves, celebrating the diversity of apples.

products.name: Virginia Goldrush Apples
products.description: A crisp, tart-sweet eating apple with a buttery finish. Perfect for snacking or baking Grandma Elmo’s famous pies.

products.name: Heirloom Apple Blossom Jelly
products.description: A fragrant, floral jelly made from blossoms and heirloom apple juice. Spread it on toast or dollop it on aged cheddar.

products.name: Foggy Hollow Hard Cider
products.description: A dry, lightly effervescent cider pressed from a blend of rare apple varietals. Unfiltered, with a wild edge. Best served chilled.

name: Merry Meadow Sheep Co.
description: Merry Meadow is a small, organic sheep dairy and wool farm on the windswept coast of Maine. Run by the irrepressible O’Connor sisters, it is known for its ethical farming, hand-crafted sheep cheeses, and lanolin-rich wool for knitters. Their farm is a haven for rare sheep breeds and a hotspot for knit-alongs and cheese tastings.

products.name: Cloudlight Feta
products.description: A briny, crumbly feta made from 100% organic sheep’s milk. Salty, tangy, and perfect for salads or Mediterranean dishes.

products.name: Lanolin Dream Wool
products.description: Soft, natural wool spun from Merry Meadow sheep and rich in lanolin. Great for hand-knitting, but be aware—lanolin can be an allergen!

products.name: Sheep's Milk Yogurt
products.description: Creamy, probiotic-rich yogurt made in small batches. Slightly grassy flavor, high in protein. Delicious with berries or honey.

name: Prairie Sun Pulse Collective
description: Based in Saskatchewan, Prairie Sun is a cooperative of organic pulse farmers specializing in lentils, chickpeas, and dry peas. United by a commitment to soil health and sustainable agriculture, they supply both bulk pulses and artisanal pulse-based foods to health-conscious consumers and local schools.

products.name: Golden Prairie Chickpeas
products.description: Dry-farmed, nutty, and buttery chickpeas—perfect for homemade hummus or roasting for snacks. Packed with protein and fiber.

products.name: Red Split Lentils
products.description: Quick-cooking, earthy lentils for soups, dals, or veggie burgers. Sustainably grown and full of iron.

products.name: Pulse Power Snack Mix
products.description: A crunchy mix of roasted chickpeas, lentils, and peas with a zesty spice blend. A protein-packed snack on the go.

name: The Nutty Squirrel Tree Nut Farm
description: On the edge of the Willamette Valley, this quirky, medium-sized family farm is a haven for nut lovers. Specializing in hazelnuts, pecans, and almonds, they offer everything from raw nuts to decadent nut butters. Their logo: a squirrel with a monocle. Sustainability is central, with integrated pest management and cover cropping.

products.name: Squirrel’s Choice Roasted Hazelnuts
products.description: Fresh, sweet hazelnuts roasted to perfection—crunchy and perfect for snacking or baking. Harvested and sorted by hand for the highest quality.

products.name: Dapper Almond Butter
products.description: Velvety smooth almond butter made from just-roasted almonds and a pinch of sea salt. No added sugars, just pure almond flavor.

products.name: Pecan Pie-in-a-Jar
products.description: A dessert spread reminiscent of classic pecan pie with chunks of toasted pecans and hints of maple. Perfect on toast or ice cream.

name: Rolling Hills Creamery
description: Nestled in the heart of Vermont, Rolling Hills Creamery is a fourth-generation family farm dedicated to crafting top-quality dairy products. Their cows graze on lush, pesticide-free pastures and the family takes pride in traditional, small-batch methods. Commitment to animal welfare, sustainability, and honest ingredients shines through every product.

products.name: Golden Pasture Whole Milk
products.description: Creamy, rich, and flavorful, this whole milk is bottled at the farm and delivers a taste of Vermont's green hills. Great for drinking, baking, or making homemade yogurt.

products.name: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk
products.description: Tangy and thick, perfect for pancakes, biscuits, or sipping straight from the bottle. A nod to the farm’s original 1920s recipe.

products.name: Rolling Hills Cheddar
products.description: Aged for 18 months, this sharp cheddar boasts a nutty finish and crumbly texture. Ideal for cheese boards or grilled cheese sandwiches.

products.name: Maple Cream Yogurt
products.description: Creamy farm yogurt swirled with locally tapped Vermont maple syrup—sweet, tangy, and rich in probiotics.

name: Sunrise Roots Organic Vegetable Co-op
description: Located on the outskirts of Eugene, Oregon, Sunrise Roots is a worker-owned cooperative specializing in certified organic root vegetables and leafy greens. Their no-till practices, cover cropping, and crop rotation ensure soil health and vibrant, delicious produce. The co-op is committed to food justice and local food security.

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Bunch
products.description: Crunchy, sweet, and colorful, this mix of heirloom carrots adds a festive touch to any salad or snack plate. Grown in rich, organic soil for incredible flavor.

products.name: Garlic Scapes
products.description: Twisty green garlic scapes with a mild, peppery flavor—excellent for pesto, stir-fries, or grilling. A true sign of summer at the co-op.

products.name: Sunrise Golden Beets
products.description: Sweet, earthy golden beets that roast to perfection or shine raw in salads. A favorite at the local farmers’ market.

products.name: Celery Fresh Stalks
products.description: Crisp, juicy celery stalks, perfect for snacks, soups, or juicing. Harvested at dawn for maximum crunch.

name: Windblown Quail Estate
description: Perched on a breezy hilltop in Sonoma, California, Windblown Quail Estate is a small, specialty farm raising Japanese and Coturnix quail for gourmet eggs and meat. Their birds enjoy fresh air, spacious coops, and a diet of local grains. The estate is known for innovation in humane poultry raising and luxurious farm-to-table experiences.

products.name: Petite Quail Eggs
products.description: Delicately speckled and rich in flavor, these petite eggs make for elegant appetizers or a unique breakfast. Loved by chefs and foodies alike.

products.name: Smoked Quail Breast
products.description: Tender, subtly smoky quail breast, ready to elevate any charcuterie board or main course. Smoked over estate-grown grapevine trimmings for a signature flavor.

products.name: Pickled Quail Eggs
products.description: A tangy, protein-packed snack with a pop of color and flavor, perfect for salads or cocktails. These pickled gems are an estate specialty.

name: The Laughing Barley Collective
description: Based in the wide-open plains of Saskatchewan, Canada, The Laughing Barley Collective is a group of regenerative grain farmers cultivating heritage barley and oats. Their mission is to bring back forgotten grains, improve soil health, and make delicious, allergen-conscious foods for modern kitchens.

products.name: Ancient Barley Flour
products.description: Stone-milled from heirloom barley varieties, this nutty flour adds depth to breads, pancakes, and pastries. Ideal for those seeking a gluten alternative to wheat.

products.name: Creamy Rolled Oats
products.description: Plump, flattened oats with a creamy texture—perfect for oatmeal, granola, and cookies. Sustainably grown and freshly milled.

products.name: Barley Berries
products.description: Whole, chewy barley grains excellent in soups and salads. A hearty, ancient grain making a modern comeback.

products.name: Golden Oat Muesli
products.description: A handcrafted blend of rolled oats, dried fruit, and seeds—no added sugar. Breakfast just got easier and tastier.

name: Big Muddy Catfish & Shrimp Farm
description: Down on the banks of the mighty Mississippi near Greenville, Mississippi, Big Muddy is a family-run aquaculture operation. They specialize in channel catfish and farm-raised freshwater shrimp. Their focus is on clean water, sustainable feed, and providing fresh, restaurant-quality seafood to the southern region.

products.name: Big Muddy Catfish Fillet
products.description: Tender, mild, and flakey, these fillets are a Southern tradition—perfect for frying, grilling, or po’boys. Raised in clean, oxygen-rich ponds.

products.name: Southern-Style Breaded Shrimp
products.description: Hand-breaded with a secret spice mix, these sweet and juicy shrimp are ready for the fryer. A true taste of the Delta.

products.name: Mississippi Fish Chowder Kit
products.description: A hearty DIY chowder kit featuring fresh catfish, sweet corn, and aromatic herbs. Just add milk and simmer for a soul-soothing meal.

name: The Nutty Squirrel Orchard & Apiary
description: Nestled on a sunny hillside in upstate New York, The Nutty Squirrel Orchard & Apiary is a third-generation family farm specializing in tree nuts, apples, and wildflower honey. Founded in the 1970s by the whimsical 'Grandma Squirrel' herself, the farm is now run by her grandkids, who are just as nutty about pollinators and biodiversity. Their philosophy centers on harmony with nature—no pesticides, plenty of cover crops, and a thriving habitat for bees and red squirrels alike.

products.name: Grandma Squirrel's Honey-Roasted Almonds
products.description: Crunchy almonds, slow-roasted and glazed with the farm’s own wildflower honey. Sweet, nutty, and with a floral finish, these are perfect for snacking or topping desserts.

products.name: Blushing Apple Blossom Honey
products.description: A fragrant, golden honey collected during peak apple blossom season. Notes of apple and wildflowers, ideal for drizzling over hot toast or yogurt.

products.name: Crisp Sunrise Apples
products.description: Heirloom apple varieties picked at dawn for peak freshness. Tart and sweet, great for pies or eating out of hand.

products.name: Squirrelly Walnut Butter
products.description: A creamy, rich walnut spread with a hint of sea salt. Perfect for toast or swirling into oatmeal. Watch for the nutty finish!

name: Mighty Green Lentil Cooperative
description: Located in the windswept plains of Saskatchewan, Mighty Green Lentil Cooperative is a farmer-owned operation dedicated to sustainable pulse crop production. Founded by local families, they rotate lentils, chickpeas, and buckwheat to enrich the soil. Their mission is to provide protein-rich, allergen-friendly, and affordable food for families far and wide. They believe in seed diversity, soil health, and honest, traceable food.

products.name: Northern Star Green Lentils
products.description: Small-batch, triple-washed green lentils with a peppery flavor and firm bite. Ideal for hearty soups, salads, and vegan curries.

products.name: Prairie Chickpeas
products.description: Creamy and nutty chickpeas perfect for hummus, roasting, or adding to stews. Grown without synthetic chemicals.

products.name: Red Buckwheat Flour
products.description: Stone-milled from hulled buckwheat grown on the co-op’s southernmost fields. Gluten-free and great for pancakes or soba noodles.

name: Snuggle Sheep Family Dairy
description: In the rolling hills of Wales, Snuggle Sheep Family Dairy is known for its small flock of pampered East Friesian sheep and a quirky sense of humor. The farm, started by the Davies family, focuses on humane animal care, rotational grazing, and old-fashioned cheesemaking. Their sheep are practically family, and every wheel of cheese comes with a story (and often a sheep pun).

products.name: Woolly White Feta
products.description: A brined, tangy feta cheese made from fresh sheep’s milk. Crumbly and perfect for salads, spanakopita, or straight off the fork.

products.name: Ewe-Phoric Yogurt
products.description: Rich, creamy sheep’s milk yogurt with a velvety texture. Excellent for breakfast, with fruit, or as a base for savory sauces.

products.name: Shear Delight Ricotta
products.description: Soft, delicate ricotta made in small batches each morning. Ideal for baking, pasta fillings, or spooning with honey. A true taste of the Welsh meadows!

products.name: Lanolin Soap Bars
products.description: Handmade soaps infused with natural lanolin from the farm’s shearing days. Moisturizing and lightly scented—great for sensitive skin, unless you’re allergic to wool!

name: Chili Charlie's Hot Pepper Patch
description: Deep in Texas, Chili Charlie's Hot Pepper Patch is a fiery operation with a cult local following. Started by Charlie Gutierrez, a self-proclaimed heat-seeker and pepper collector, the farm grows over 30 varieties of chili peppers, from mild poblanos to scorching Carolina Reapers. Charlie believes food should make you sweat and laugh in equal measure. The farm specializes in fresh and dried peppers, spicy sauces, and tongue-tingling jams.

products.name: Texas Twister Hot Sauce
products.description: A bright, vinegar-forward hot sauce made from Charlie’s cayenne, serrano, and habanero blend. Packs a flavorful punch with a slow burn that sneaks up on you.

products.name: Reaper Pepper Jelly
products.description: A sweet-and-fiery red jelly made from Carolina Reaper peppers. Fantastic with cheese or as a wild glaze for pork.

products.name: Charred Jalapeño Powder
products.description: A smoky, medium-heat powder for sprinkling on popcorn, pizza, or grilled corn. Made from hand-smoked jalapeños, ground on-site.

name: Sunrise Sunflower & Pumpkin Collective
description: This sunny, woman-led collective in eastern Ukraine specializes in sunflowers and pumpkins. They operate on regenerative principles, rotating crops and using pollinator-friendly practices. Their mission: celebrate seeds and squash in all forms, from healthy snacks to rich, golden oils. The farm supports displaced women farmers and is a model for sustainability and community-led agriculture.

products.name: Golden Sunrise Sunflower Oil
products.description: Cold-pressed sunflower oil with a light, nutty flavor. Perfect for dressings, frying, or baking. Bottled in recyclable glass.

products.name: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds (Salted)
products.description: Crunchy, protein-packed pumpkin seeds, lightly salted and roasted. Great for snacking or as salad toppers. Kids love them!

products.name: Pumpkin Patch Puree
products.description: Smooth, naturally sweet pumpkin puree, perfect for pies, soups, or autumnal smoothies. The taste of fall in every spoonful.

name: The Rowdy Rooster Eggery
description: Nestled on the outskirts of Omaha, The Rowdy Rooster Eggery is a third-generation family farm dedicated to the happy lives of their free-range hens. Their philosophy is simple: happy hens, better eggs! With a focus on sustainability and animal welfare, they produce a range of specialty, gourmet, and classic egg products for foodies and families alike.

products.name: Rowdy Rooster Jumbo Brown Eggs
products.description: Fresh, free-range jumbo brown eggs with rich golden yolks, perfect for breakfast, baking, or a hearty omelet.

products.name: Devilish Double-Yolk Eggs
products.description: A rare double-yolk treat, these eggs are a surprise in every carton—beloved by bakers and breakfast lovers alike.

products.name: Pickled Rooster Eggs
products.description: A tangy, protein-packed snack. These eggs are pickled in a family recipe brine for a savory, zesty punch—ideal for charcuterie boards.

name: Barley & Rye Brothers Cooperative
description: Based in the rolling fields of Saskatchewan, Barley & Rye Brothers Cooperative brings together over 40 small-grain farmers. Founded during the 1980s farm crisis, the co-op focuses on heritage grains, regenerative practices, and supporting rural communities. Their grains are highly sought after by craft brewers, bakers, and health-conscious home cooks.

products.name: Golden Barley Berries
products.description: Whole barley grains with a nutty, chewy texture—perfect for soups, salads, and home milling. Often the secret ingredient in local beers!

products.name: Rustic Rye Flour
products.description: Freshly milled rye flour, ideal for tangy sourdough and dense European breads. Grown without synthetic pesticides for a robust, earthy flavor.

products.name: Barley Malt Syrup
products.description: A rich, sweet syrup made from sprouted barley. Essential for brewing, baking, or as a natural sweetener in granola bars.

name: Mrs. Greenbean’s Veggie Patch
description: A quirky, organic market garden in Mendocino County, Mrs. Greenbean’s specializes in hard-to-find heirloom and colorful vegetables. The farm is known for its whimsical approach, compost-powered irrigation, and a lively Saturday farmers’ market stall. Their seasonal produce inspires both home chefs and local restaurants.

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Medley
products.description: A crunchy bouquet of purple, orange, and yellow heirloom carrots. Sweet, earthy, and perfect for snacking or roasting.

products.name: Purple Haze Garlic
products.description: A striking purple-skinned garlic with robust flavor—delicious raw or roasted, and a visual showstopper in any dish.

products.name: Greenbean’s Zucchini Noodles
products.description: Hand-spiraled zucchini noodles for gluten-free pasta lovers; great sautéed or tossed in salads. Locally known as ‘noodlini.’

name: Old Maple Hollow
description: Set among Vermont’s ancient sugar maples, Old Maple Hollow is a fourth-generation farm producing organic, wood-fired maple syrup and maple specialties. Family-run, they pride themselves on traditional sap collection, forest stewardship, and a rustic sugar shack open to visitors during sugaring season.

products.name: Amber Rich Maple Syrup
products.description: Smooth, buttery maple syrup with hints of vanilla—drizzle on pancakes or use as a natural sweetener. Wood-fired for depth of flavor.

products.name: Maple Sugar Candy
products.description: Melt-in-your-mouth candies made by boiling down pure maple syrup—an iconic New England treat for all ages.

products.name: Maple Cream Spread
products.description: A velvety, sweet maple spread for toast, pastries, or by the spoonful. Made from only one ingredient: pure maple syrup.

name: Happy Valley Goat Farmstead
description: A small but mighty goat dairy outside Asheville, North Carolina, Happy Valley is run by two sisters devoted to humane animal care and innovative, farmstead cheeses. Their pasture-raised goats wander forested hills, producing milk for award-winning, tangy, and creamy cheeses. Tours and goat yoga are a local favorite.

products.name: Happy Valley Fresh Chevre
products.description: A soft, spreadable goat cheese with a tangy, citrusy note—amazing on crackers or salads. Handmade in small batches.

products.name: Garlic & Herb Goat Feta
products.description: Crumbly, brined goat feta infused with local herbs and garlic. Perfect for Greek salads or stuffed peppers.

products.name: Goat’s Milk Yogurt
products.description: Rich and creamy yogurt with a gentle tang, made from whole goat’s milk. Delicious with honey, fruit, or granola.

name: Sunny Pastures Dairy Collective
description: Sunny Pastures Dairy Collective is a multi-generational family-run dairy farm nestled in the rolling hills of Wisconsin. Founded in 1979, they specialize in high-quality cow's milk dairy products, championing sustainable grazing, animal welfare, and local employment. Their philosophy is to bring the freshest, most flavorful dairy straight from their pastures to the community, all while minimizing environmental impact.

products.name: Sunrise Whole Milk
products.description: Rich, creamy whole milk from grass-fed cows. Perfect for drinking, baking, or crafting a luxurious latte. Pasteurized and bottled on-site for maximum freshness.

products.name: Golden Churn Butter
products.description: Hand-churned from the freshest cream, this butter boasts a sunny yellow color and a sweet, grassy flavor. Ideal for slathering on homemade bread or melting atop vegetables.

products.name: Field Blossom Yogurt
products.description: Thick, tangy yogurt made with live cultures and top-tier cow's milk. Enjoy plain, with fruit, or as a base for savory dips. A breakfast favorite with a probiotic punch.

products.name: Old-Fashioned Cheese Curds
products.description: Squeaky, fresh cheese curds with a mild, milky flavor. Beloved for snacking or tossing onto hot fries for classic poutine.

products.name: Heritage Aged Cheddar
products.description: Aged over twelve months, this sharp cheddar develops crystals and a rich, nutty finish. Excellent for cheese boards or melting into gourmet grilled cheese sandwiches.

name: Blue Ribbon Orchard
description: Located in upstate New York, Blue Ribbon Orchard is an organic-certified, family-run farm with a passion for apples and other classic orchard fruits. Founded by the Nguyen family in the 1960s, the orchard is proud of its integrated pest management and commitment to biodiversity. They host annual apple-picking festivals and are known for heritage varieties and inventive apple treats.

products.name: Empire Crunch Apples
products.description: Crisp, juicy apples with a sweet-tart flavor, harvested at peak ripeness. Perfect for snacking or baking pies.

products.name: Apple Butter Spread
products.description: A velvety, spiced spread made by slow-cooking apples with cinnamon and nutmeg. Great on toast or as a swirl in oatmeal.

products.name: Honeycrisp Apple Cider
products.description: Cold-pressed, unfiltered cider with a bright, sweet flavor and a refreshing finish. The essence of fall in a bottle.

products.name: Spiced Orchard Donuts
products.description: Fluffy donuts made with orchard apples and warming spices. A festival favorite, dusted with cinnamon sugar.

name: Bumblebuzz Apiaries
description: Bumblebuzz Apiaries is a quirky, community-supported urban beekeeping operation in Portland, Oregon. Run by a pair of enthusiastic siblings, they cultivate honeybee hives in local gardens and rooftops, producing small-batch, raw honey and bee-related products. Their mission is to support pollinator health, educate the public, and sweeten city life.

products.name: Neighborhood Wildflower Honey
products.description: Raw, unfiltered honey with nuanced floral notes, reflecting the diversity of city gardens. Ideal for sweetening tea or drizzling over yogurt.

products.name: Beekeeper's Bee Pollen
products.description: Collected by bees from a medley of blossoms, these golden granules are sprinkled over smoothies by health enthusiasts. Handle with care: bee pollen is a potent allergen!

products.name: Royal Jelly Boost
products.description: A rare, nutrient-packed substance produced for the queen bee. Marketed as a superfood, it's used in skincare and supplements. Not suitable for those with bee allergies.

name: Fuzzy Friends Fiber Farm
description: Set on the edge of Vermont’s Green Mountains, Fuzzy Friends Fiber Farm is a small, woman-owned operation specializing in sheep and alpaca wool. The farm practices regenerative grazing and focuses on gentle, ethical shearing. Their boutique yarn and wool products are beloved by local knitters, and their eco-friendly philosophy has earned them a cult following.

products.name: Cloudsoft Alpaca Yarn
products.description: Luxuriously soft yarn spun from the farm’s herd of friendly alpacas. Great for knitting scarves, hats, and baby blankets.

products.name: Shepherd's Choice Wool Roving
products.description: Premium, undyed sheep’s wool roving for felting and spinning. Sourced from happy, pasture-raised sheep.

products.name: Farmstead Lanolin Balm
products.description: A soothing balm made from purified sheep wool lanolin and local beeswax. Moisturizes dry hands and is popular with knitters and gardeners.

name: Crimson Clover Chickpea Co-op
description: Deep in the heart of Colorado’s high plains, Crimson Clover Chickpea Co-op is a farmer-owned collective focusing on sustainable legume production. They rotate crops to restore soil health and specialize in chickpeas and lentils. Their products are plant-based, protein-rich, and cater to the growing demand for eco-friendly, allergen-conscious foods.

products.name: Golden Prairie Chickpeas
products.description: Nutty, creamy chickpeas perfect for salads, curries, or homemade hummus. Grown with minimal irrigation and harvested at peak ripeness.

products.name: Classic Hummus Spread
products.description: Smooth, savory hummus blended with tahini, garlic, and lemon. A Mediterranean staple, great as a dip or sandwich spread.

products.name: Smoky Chickpea Snackers
products.description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas dusted with smoked paprika and sea salt. A protein-packed snack for on-the-go munching.

name: Rocky Ridge Heritage Grains
description: Nestled in the high plains of Colorado, Rocky Ridge Heritage Grains is a third-generation family farm committed to reviving ancient and heirloom grains.
