They specialize in organic, low-input farming and direct-mill their grains to preserve nutrition and flavor. The farm is passionate about supporting local bakers and promoting diverse, climate-resilient crops.

products.name: Heirloom Red Fife Wheat Flour
products.description: Stone-milled from heritage Red Fife wheat, this flour boasts a nutty flavor and gorgeous golden hue. Perfect for rustic sourdoughs, pizzas, and pastries that demand depth of flavor.

products.name: Purple Prairie Barley Berries
products.description: These chewy, violet-hued barley berries cook up beautifully in soups and salads and provide a hearty nutty bite. Grown organically and harvested at peak sweetness.

products.name: Buckwheat Pancake Mix
products.description: A gluten-friendly pancake mix featuring earthy Rocky Ridge buckwheat and a touch of local honey powder. Perfect for Sunday brunches or hearty camping breakfasts.

name: Happy Quackers Duck Farm
description: Located on the rainy outskirts of Portland, Oregon, Happy Quackers Duck Farm is a quirky, family-run operation specializing in free-range ducks and duck eggs. With a personality as bright as their waddling flock, the farm focuses on sustainable, humane animal husbandry and introduces city dwellers to the joys of duck-based cuisine.

products.name: Golden Yolker Duck Eggs
products.description: These jumbo, golden-yolked duck eggs are beloved by bakers for their rich flavor and are perfect for fluffy omelets and decadent pastries. Raised on pasture, the eggs have a unique taste that sets them apart.

products.name: Duck Confit Legs
products.description: Slow-cooked in their own fat, these tender duck legs are a French classic ready to be crisped up for a gourmet meal. Just heat and eat for a taste of countryside luxury.

products.name: Featherlight Pillow Inserts
products.description: Ultra-soft pillow inserts filled with cleaned and sanitized duck feathers, perfect for a natural, hypoallergenic (for most!) sleep experience. Warning: May induce spontaneous napping.

name: Global Roots Veggie Collective
description: A multicultural cooperative in the heart of Toronto, Global Roots Veggie Collective brings together immigrant growers from over a dozen countries. They focus on vegetables and herbs seldom found in mainstream markets, promoting food diversity and supporting newcomer farmers as they grow culturally meaningful produce.

products.name: Thai Holy Basil Bunches
products.description: Fragrant, spicy, and slightly sweet, this authentic Thai Holy Basil infuses stir-fries and curries with a peppery punch. Harvested at dawn for peak freshness.

products.name: Purple Yam (Ube) Tubers
products.description: Globally beloved for desserts, these vivid purple yams have a subtle sweet flavor and creamy texture, perfect for cakes, ice cream, or roasting. A feast for the eyes and taste buds.

products.name: Carrot Rainbow Mix
products.description: A medley of heirloom carrots—orange, purple, yellow, and red—each with a distinct flavor profile. Great for roasting, snacking, or adding color to salads.

name: Nutty Nomad Orchard & Nutworks
description: Tucked away in the rolling hills of northern California, Nutty Nomad is a small, certified-organic farm focusing on tree nuts and unusual fruit varieties. Founded by two former backpackers, they celebrate experimentation, biodiversity, and nutty humor in all their endeavors.

products.name: Raw Mission Almonds
products.description: Sweet, crisp, and minimally processed, these almonds are perfect for snacking or adding crunch to salads and baked goods. Grown using regenerative practices.

products.name: Walnut Butter Spread
products.description: A silky-smooth, rich walnut butter made from their own crop—delicious on toast or blended into smoothies. A nutty alternative to peanut butter!

products.name: Fresh Pecan Halves
products.description: Sweet and meaty pecans, hand-cracked and ready for pies, salads, or simply snacking by the handful. Taste autumn in every bite!

name: Firewheel Pepper Patch
description: On the sunbaked outskirts of San Antonio, Texas, Firewheel Pepper Patch is an organic micro-farm specializing in heritage chili peppers and culinary hot sauces. Fiercely independent and proud of their spicy roots, the farm is a family effort, blending Mexican and Texan growing traditions with relentless innovation.

products.name: Flaming Firewheel Hot Sauce
products.description: This signature hot sauce blends five heirloom chili varieties into a bright, fiery, and complex condiment. Perfect for tacos, eggs, or spicing up your margarita rim.

products.name: Mild 'N' Wild Anaheim Peppers
products.description: Large, mild green peppers with a tangy bite, great for stuffing or grilling. Grown for flavor, not just heat!

products.name: Smoked Poblano Salsa
products.description: Slow-smoked over mesquite and blended with roasted garlic and onions, this salsa delivers deep flavor without overwhelming heat. A Tex-Mex essential.

name: Pasture Song Creamery
description: Nestled in the lush hills of Vermont, Pasture Song Creamery is a third-generation family dairy farm passionate about producing artisanal cheeses and yogurts. Their cows graze on open pastures, and the creamery is powered by renewable energy. They believe that happy cows make the best cheese, and their products are a testament to that philosophy.

products.name: Meadow Gold Aged Cheddar
products.description: A sharp, tangy Vermont cheddar made from the milk of grass-fed cows, aged for a full year to develop its nutty, complex flavor. Perfect for snacking, melting, or gourmet sandwiches.

products.name: Sunrise Vanilla Yogurt
products.description: Creamy, mildly sweet yogurt infused with real vanilla beans, ideal for breakfast or as a nutritious snack. Made only from the freshest morning milk.

products.name: Herb Blossom Ricotta
products.description: Soft, spreadable ricotta cheese blended with handpicked garden herbs and edible flowers. A favorite for springtime brunches and pasta dishes.

name: Whistling Willow Apiary
description: A quirky, eco-friendly bee farm located just outside Portland, Oregon. Whistling Willow is run by a group of bee enthusiasts dedicated to pollinator health and urban agriculture. They specialize in unique honey varietals and bee-related goodies, always with a nod to sustainability and education.

products.name: Wildflower Harmony Honey
products.description: Raw honey collected from bees foraging on a diverse mix of urban wildflowers. Each jar captures the floral essence of Portland’s spring bloom.

products.name: Honeybee Pollen Power Bites
products.description: Chewy snack bites made from local honey, oats, and bee pollen. Popular with athletes and health nuts—just beware if you’re pollen-sensitive!

name: Boulder Barrel Mushroom Collective
description: A worker-owned cooperative in Boulder, Colorado, specializing in gourmet and medicinal mushrooms. Using organic methods and innovative log cultivation, they provide fresh fungi to restaurants, markets, and fungi fans alike. Education and mycological curiosity are at the core of their mission.

products.name: Lion’s Mane Brain Boost Powder
products.description: Finely milled powder from organically grown Lion’s Mane mushrooms, prized for its nutty flavor and purported cognitive benefits. Great in coffee or smoothies.

products.name: Velvet Shiitake Clusters
products.description: Thick, umami-rich Shiitake mushrooms grown on oak logs. Favored by chefs for their meaty texture and earthy taste.

products.name: Chef’s Forager Mix (Fresh)
products.description: A rotating, hand-picked assortment of oyster, maitake, and pioppino mushrooms. Perfect for adventurous home cooks and market baskets.

name: Sunset Grove Citrus
description: Located on the sun-drenched hillsides of California’s Central Valley, Sunset Grove is a mid-sized family grove specializing in heirloom and specialty citrus. Their philosophy: the stranger the fruit, the sweeter the juice! They’re known for reviving rare varieties and experimenting with cross-pollination for bold new flavors.

products.name: Ruby Tango Mandarins
products.description: A vibrant, seedless mandarin-orange hybrid with a punchy sweet-tart flavor and a hint of raspberry. Ideal for snacking and salads.

products.name: Buddha’s Hand Marmalade
products.description: A fragrant marmalade made from the ancient Buddha’s Hand citron, prized for its floral citrus aroma. A unique spread for toast or cheese boards.

name: Fuzzy Bottom Sheep & Fiber Farm
description: High in the rolling Blue Ridge Mountains, Fuzzy Bottom is a sustainable, woman-owned sheep farm focused on heritage wool breeds and small-batch dairy. Their sheep graze on wildflower meadows and the farm is open for agritourism, workshops, and the occasional sheep yoga session.

products.name: Wooly Wonder Yarn (Undyed)
products.description: Super-soft, undyed yarn spun from the fleece of rare Bluefaced Leicester sheep. Great for sensitive skin but watch out if you’re lanolin-allergic!

products.name: Shepherd’s Halloumi
products.description: A grillable, squeaky sheep’s milk cheese with a salty bite and a cult following at local markets. Excellent with grilled vegetables or watermelon.

name: Golden Field Grains Co-op
description: Golden Field Grains Co-op is a collective of small family-run grain farms located in central Nebraska. United by their dedication to sustainable agriculture and crop rotation, the co-op specializes in heritage wheat, barley, and oats. The group is passionate about soil health, supporting pollinator habitats, and creating hearty, nutritious grains for artisan bakers and brewers.

products.name: Prairie Heirloom Wheat Flour
products.description: Stone-milled from ancient wheat varieties grown using regenerative practices, this flour boasts a robust, nutty flavor. Perfect for rustic breads and hearty pastas, it's a favorite among local bakeries.

products.name: Sunrise Barley Berries
products.description: These chewy, whole barley berries are ideal for salads, soups, or brewing. Grown with minimal irrigation, they have a mild, earthy taste and a delightful bite.

products.name: Oat Groats Supreme
products.description: Tender, slightly sweet oat groats harvested at peak freshness. They cook up creamy for breakfast bowls or can be added to hearty soups for extra texture. Certified free from cross-contact with wheat.

name: Happy Quacks Duck Farm
description: Nestled by a winding brook in Vermont, Happy Quacks Duck Farm is a family-run operation specializing in pasture-raised ducks and duck eggs. Their ducks enjoy swimming, foraging, and living a stress-free life. The farm is known for its ethically produced, rich duck eggs and a few quirky byproducts.

products.name: Golden Yolker Duck Eggs
products.description: These large, vibrant-yolked eggs are beloved by pastry chefs for their creaminess and ability to make cakes extra fluffy. Ducks are raised on open pasture and non-GMO feed.

products.name: Pasture Duck Fat Jar
products.description: Rendered from pasture-raised ducks, this silky fat is prized for frying potatoes or adding depth to savory dishes. It brings a decadent, old-world flavor to modern kitchens.

products.name: Downright Soft Duck Down
products.description: The softest down harvested from molting ducks, ideal for stuffing pillows, comforters, or as a gift for someone who deserves a cloud to sleep on. Hypoallergenic for most, but can affect those with feather sensitivities.

name: Blue Sky Orchard
description: Located on the gentle slopes of Washington’s Yakima Valley, Blue Sky Orchard is a third-generation fruit farm specializing in apples, pears, and stone fruits. Committed to integrated pest management and eco-friendly packaging, they are famous for their diverse heirloom apple varieties and crisp, juicy fruit.

products.name: Crimson Gala Apples
products.description: Vivid red with sweet, tangy flesh, these apples are hand-picked at peak ripeness. Great for eating fresh or baking classic pies. Fun fact: Each apple is polished by hand before shipping!

products.name: Orchard-Fresh Pears
products.description: These Bartlett and Anjou pears are impossibly juicy and fragrant. Enjoy them sliced on a cheese board or poached with spices for a cozy dessert.

products.name: Heirloom Apple Cider
products.description: A small-batch, unfiltered cider pressed from a blend of antique apple varieties. Tart, aromatic, and bursting with orchard character. Delicious hot or cold!

name: Nutty By Nature Grove
description: Nutty By Nature Grove is a quirky, family-owned tree nut farm tucked away in California’s Central Valley. Specializing in almonds, pecans, and the occasional experimental hazelnut, they pride themselves on water conservation, solar-powered processing, and making nut-lovers’ dreams come true.

products.name: Crunchy Raw Almonds
products.description: Hand-harvested and gently sun-dried, these almonds are packed with flavor and ideal for snacking, baking, or making fresh almond milk at home.

products.name: Salted Pecan Halves
products.description: Pecans, lightly roasted and tossed with just the right touch of sea salt. Sweet, buttery, and absolutely addictive. Perfect for desserts or topping oatmeal.

products.name: Choco-Hazelnut Spread Experiment #9
products.description: A limited-run, chocolate-hazelnut spread using their own hazelnuts and real cocoa. The ninth recipe was finally declared "dangerously delicious."

name: Urban Root Veg Collective
description: Urban Root Veg Collective is a group of city-based micro-farms in Detroit, Michigan, focused on regenerative, small-batch root vegetable production. Passionate about community food access and soil restoration, they grow quirky carrots, heirloom potatoes, and specialty beets year-round in hoop houses and vertical beds.

products.name: Rainbow Heirloom Carrots
products.description: An eye-catching bundle of purple, yellow, and orange carrots with sweet, earthy flavors. Perfect for raw snacking or roasting. Each color brings a different phytonutrient benefit!

products.name: Detroit Ruby Beets
products.description: Deep red, earthy beets loved by chefs for salads, juicing, and baking into chocolate beet brownies (trust us!). No major allergens, just pure beet goodness.

products.name: Golden Spud Potatoes
products.description: Creamy, yellow-fleshed potatoes with buttery flavor and a smooth texture—great for mashing, soups, or crispy oven fries. Michigan’s best-kept spud secret.

name: Cloudberry Pastures Creamery
description: Nestled in the green hills of Vermont, Cloudberry Pastures Creamery is a third-generation family farm known for its small-batch, artisanal dairy creations. With a focus on sustainable grazing and animal welfare, the farm crafts unique cheeses and yogurts featuring both cow's and goat's milk. Their philosophy: milk quality starts with happy animals and lush, chemical-free fields.

products.name: Cloudberry Reserve Aged Cheddar
products.description: A sharp, buttery cheddar aged for 24 months in the farm's stone cellar. Perfect for cheese boards or gourmet melts. Made exclusively from grass-fed cow's milk, giving it a complex, nutty finish.

products.name: Maple Swirl Goat Yogurt
products.description: Smooth, tangy goat's milk yogurt sweetened lightly with local Vermont maple syrup. Beloved for breakfast parfaits and healthy snacking. Naturally probiotic-rich and easier to digest for some than cow's milk products.

products.name: Cloudberry Farmhouse Blue
products.description: A bold blue cheese with creamy veins and a tangy bite. The unique flavor comes from the natural cave-aging process and the farm’s blend of cow's and goat's milk. A true showstopper for cheese aficionados.

name: Sassy Sprout Microfarm
description: A quirky urban microfarm in Portland, Oregon, Sassy Sprout specializes in pesticide-free microgreens and edible flowers. Founded by a pair of botanist best friends, they focus on super-fresh, highly nutritious greens harvested to order for local restaurants and foodies. Their motto: "Tiny but mighty!"

products.name: Radish Rainbow Mix Microgreens
products.description: A spicy, colorful blend of red and purple radish shoots, perfect for topping tacos, salads, and sandwiches. The bold, peppery flavor adds crunch and a nutrient boost to any dish.

products.name: Edible Flower Confetti
products.description: A vibrant mix of pesticide-free nasturtiums, violas, and calendula petals. Adds beauty and floral notes to desserts, salads, or fancy cocktails. Each batch is hand-harvested at peak bloom.

name: Humble Buck Ranch
description: Located in the rolling plains of Texas, Humble Buck Ranch raises heritage goat breeds on wide open pastures. The family-run operation is renowned for its humane practices and small-batch goat meat, milk, and soaps. They believe in respect for animals and the land, producing products that reflect their care and commitment.

products.name: Smoked Chevon Sausage
products.description: Artisan sausage made from pasture-raised goat meat, smoked over Texas pecan wood for a deep, savory flavor. A favorite at local barbecues and farmers’ markets, great on the grill or in gumbo.

products.name: Humble Buck Goat Milk Soap
products.description: Luxurious, hand-poured soap bars made with fresh goat milk, olive oil, and local wildflowers. Gentle on skin, with a creamy lather and subtle floral scent. No added dyes or chemicals.

name: Crimson Vineyards Collective
description: An organic, worker-owned vineyard in California’s Sonoma Valley, Crimson Vineyards produces boutique wines and grape products with an emphasis on biodiversity and regenerative practices. Their small but mighty team hand-picks every grape and uses solar energy to power their cellar operations.

products.name: Pinot Noir Nightfall
products.description: A limited-release organic Pinot Noir with notes of dark cherry and spice. Crafted from hand-harvested grapes and aged in French oak barrels. Pairs beautifully with roast lamb or mushroom risotto.

products.name: Sparkling Grape Elixir
products.description: A non-alcoholic, effervescent grape juice made from estate-grown Concord and Muscat grapes. Bright and refreshing, perfect for celebrations big or small. No added sugars or artificial flavors.

name: The Bearded Beetroot Brothers
description: Founded by three bearded siblings in the Black Forest region of Germany, this quirky farm specializes in root vegetables and pickles. Famous for their humorous marketing and mustachioed beets logo, they use old-world techniques to bring out the best in every root, focusing on heirloom varieties and natural fermentation.

products.name: Grandma’s Ruby Beet Pickles
products.description: Tangy, garlicky pickled beets made according to a secret family recipe passed down from Oma. Crunchy, sweet, and a little earthy—delightful on sandwiches or straight from the jar.

products.name: Fermented Rainbow Carrots
products.description: Striped heirloom carrots, lacto-fermented for a sour punch and probiotic boost. The perfect snack for gut health and vibrant charcuterie boards.

name: Blue Moon Apiaries
description: Nestled on the gentle slopes of Oregon’s Willamette Valley, Blue Moon Apiaries has been a family-run beekeeping operation for three generations. The Tully family takes pride in their sustainable hive management, wildflower pollinator gardens, and commitment to natural beekeeping techniques. Their mission is to support local ecology while producing honey and related products bursting with unique floral notes.

products.name: Midnight Wildflower Honey
products.description: A delicate, golden honey harvested from nocturnal blooming wildflowers. Its complex flavor profile features subtle notes of star thistle and moonflower. Perfect for drizzling over toast, pairing with blue cheese, or stirring into herbal teas.

products.name: Pollen Power Granules
products.description: Collected directly from their hives, these bee pollen granules are beloved by health enthusiasts for smoothies and yogurt bowls, offering a floral, slightly bitter crunch.

products.name: Buzzed Beeswax Candles
products.description: Hand-poured from excess beeswax, these sweet-smelling candles light up any room with their gentle amber glow. Clean burning and all-natural, they’re a staple at local farmers markets.

name: The Laughing Quinoa Collective
description: Founded by a group of idealistic young farmers in the Colorado high plains, this cooperative specializes in ancient grains adapted for the modern palate. Known for their eco-friendly no-till farming methods, they focus on alternative grains and legumes, promoting soil health and culinary diversity.

products.name: Jovial Quinoa Blend
products.description: A colorful mix of red, black, and white quinoa, grown organically and hand-sorted for perfect cooking. Nutty, fluffy, and versatile—ideal for salads, bowls, or as a protein-rich side.

products.name: Cheeky Chickpea Flour
products.description: Stone-milled from local chickpeas, this flour brings a slightly sweet taste and dense texture to pancakes, fritters, and flatbreads. High in protein and naturally gluten-free.

name: Sunshine Orchard & Cidery
description: Tucked away in upstate New York, this family-owned orchard has grown heritage apples and pears for over 50 years. They recently expanded into small-batch, artisanal cider production. The orchard is known for its eco-friendly pest management, heirloom varieties, and lively fall festivals.

products.name: Heritage Apple Cider
products.description: Crafted from a blend of rare apple varieties, this crisp, slightly tart cider is naturally fermented and unfiltered. Enjoy chilled on a hot day or warmed with spices in autumn.

products.name: Golden Delicious Apple Butter
products.description: Rich, slow-cooked apple butter with hints of cinnamon and clove. Perfect on toast, oatmeal, or as a decadent swirl in yogurt.

products.name: Sparkling Pear Shrub
products.description: A tangy, effervescent drink made from hand-pressed pears and raw apple cider vinegar, sweetened with a touch of wildflower honey. Refreshing and probiotic-rich.

name: The Tipsy Tomato Patch
description: This quirky urban micro-farm in downtown Chicago operates rooftop greenhouses dedicated to growing tomatoes in all shapes and sizes. The small team of horticulturists is passionate about flavor, sustainability, and city greening—offering unique tomato-based products for adventurous taste buds.

products.name: Funky Cherry Tomato Medley
products.description: An eye-catching assortment of sun-ripened cherry tomatoes—yellow pear, black zebra, and green grape. Bursting with sweet, tangy flavor and perfect for salads or snacking.

products.name: Firecracker Tomato Jam
products.description: This sweet and spicy jam features heirloom tomatoes, a dash of chili for heat, and a splash of cider vinegar. Ideal with cheese boards or gourmet sandwiches.

name: Rolling Barley Acres
description: Located on the breezy prairies of Saskatchewan, Rolling Barley Acres is a fourth-generation family farm focusing on premium barley and oats. Their philosophy blends tradition with innovation: rotational cropping, natural pest control, and a deep respect for the land. They partner with regional bakeries and breweries, supplying grains known for flavor and freshness.

products.name: Golden Prairie Barley
products.description: Hulled and cleaned barley with a nutty, slightly sweet flavor. Used for soups, salads, or home brewing. Grown under sunny prairie skies for optimal taste.

products.name: Silver Mist Oat Groats
products.description: Whole oat groats, hearty and chewy, perfect for breakfast bowls or rustic bread baking. Their natural, earthy taste comes from careful post-harvest handling.

products.name: Prairie Sun Granola
products.description: A crunchy blend of oats, barley flakes, honey, and roasted seeds. Toasted until golden, this granola is a breakfast and hiking snack favorite.

name: Willow & Wool Family Dairy
description: Nestled in the rolling pastures of Vermont, Willow & Wool Family Dairy has been in the Hargrove family for five generations. They believe in the happy-cow philosophy, letting their Jersey cows graze on lush grass and socializing with the resident flock of sheep. Known for their small-batch yogurt and artisan cheeses, they blend tradition with modern sustainability, powering their creamery with solar energy.

products.name: Creamy Cloud Jersey Yogurt
products.description: A luxuriously thick yogurt with a naturally sweet, tangy flavor, made from the milk of pasture-raised Jersey cows. Perfect for breakfast parfaits or as a base for smoothies.

products.name: Golden Pasture Aged Cheddar
products.description: A sharp, crumbly cheddar aged 18 months, with nutty undertones and a grassy aroma. Best enjoyed with crackers or melted into a gourmet grilled cheese.

products.name: Woolly Lane Sheep Cheese
products.description: A rich, creamy cheese made exclusively from the flock’s sheep milk. Its earthy flavor is excellent for salads or a cheese board centerpiece.

products.name: Lanolin Hand Balm (Sheep’s Wool)
products.description: A soothing, all-natural balm crafted from the lanolin collected during spring shearing. Perfect for dry hands after a day on the farm.

name: Peck & Plume Eggery Cooperative
description: Located just outside Austin, Texas, Peck & Plume Eggery Cooperative brings together small flock owners passionate about raising heritage breeds and producing ethically sourced eggs. Their colorful dozen cartons are a favorite at local markets, and the cooperative’s mission is to educate on humane hen care and sustainable feed.

products.name: Sunrise Rainbow Eggs
products.description: A visually stunning dozen of blue, green, brown, and white eggs, each laid by a different heritage breed. Rich yolks and firm whites are perfect for breakfast or baking.

products.name: Deviled Darlings (Pre-made Deviled Eggs)
products.description: Classic Southern-style deviled eggs, whipped with a touch of mustard and paprika, ready to serve at your next picnic. A creamy, tangy delight.

name: The Mighty Bean Organic Soy Farm
description: Deep in Iowa’s fertile heartland, The Mighty Bean is a certified organic operation focusing on non-GMO soybeans. Founded by agronomist twins, they rotate their crops, experiment with edamame varieties, and believe in minimizing chemical use to protect pollinators.

products.name: Edamame Snacking Pods
products.description: Nutty, sweet, and plump organic edamame harvested at peak freshness. Great as a protein-rich snack or tossed into salads.

products.name: Silky Tofu Bricks
products.description: Mild and delicate, this organic tofu is made using traditional Japanese methods. It’s velvety smooth and perfect for miso soup or smoothies.

products.name: Soybean Tempeh Slabs
products.description: Firm, nutty, and full of umami, their tempeh is a vegan favorite for grilling or stir-fries. Packed with protein and probiotics.

name: Funky Fungi Forest Farm
description: Hidden beneath the redwoods in coastal Oregon, Funky Fungi is a micro farm specializing in gourmet and medicinal mushrooms. They cultivate shiitake, oyster, and even rare lion’s mane in recycled wood logs, and their farm tours are legendary for whimsical mushroom puns.

products.name: Dancing Shiitake Medley
products.description: A fragrant blend of shiitake mushrooms, prized for their meaty texture and deep umami flavor. Perfect for risottos, stir-fries, or simply sautéed.

products.name: Lion’s Mane Brain-Boost Powder
products.description: Dried and finely ground lion’s mane mushrooms, renowned for their cognitive benefits. Add a spoonful to your morning coffee or smoothie for a brainy start.

name: Sunpetal Berry Patch
description: In the gentle hills of North Carolina, Sunpetal Berry Patch is a women-run, environmentally friendly operation. Established by three sisters, they focus on pesticide-free strawberries, blueberries, and seasonal wildflowers. They champion pollinator habitats and support local bee-keepers.

products.name: Berry Bliss Strawberry Jam
products.description: A sweet and tangy jam bursting with sun-ripened strawberries. Spread on toast, swirl into yogurt, or bake into thumbprint cookies.

products.name: Blueberry Sunrise Muffins
products.description: Moist, fluffy muffins packed with juicy blueberries. A breakfast favorite, best enjoyed warm with a hint of butter.

products.name: Strawberry Fields Forever (Fresh Strawberries)
products.description: Hand-picked, ruby-red strawberries, sweet and aromatic. Eat by the handful or slice into summer salads.

name: Golden Ear Cornery
description: Nestled in the rolling plains of Iowa, Golden Ear Cornery is a fourth-generation family farm specializing in the cultivation and innovative use of sweet corn. The farm, run by the Jensen family, combines traditional farming practices with sustainable modern techniques. Their corn is famous in the region for its sweetness and plump, golden kernels. Golden Ear Cornery is committed to eco-friendly agriculture and community outreach, hosting annual corn festivals and school tours.

products.name: Sunrise Sweet Corn
products.description: Our flagship fresh-picked, sun-ripened sweet corn, perfect for grilling, steaming, or using in salads. Harvested daily during the summer season for maximum flavor and crunch.

products.name: Cornmeal Gold
products.description: Stone-ground cornmeal made from our premium golden corn. Ideal for cornbread, muffins, and pancakes. Adds a subtly sweet, earthy flavor to baked goods.

products.name: Corn Cob Jelly
products.description: A Midwestern classic, this sweet, delicate jelly is made from the juices of our best corn cobs. Perfect on toast or paired with cheese, it's a true taste of Iowa summers.

name: Orchard & Vine Heirloom Collective
description: Located in New York's Hudson Valley, Orchard & Vine Heirloom Collective unites local fruit growers to preserve rare and heritage apple and grape varieties. The cooperative is dedicated to sustainable fruit production, biodiversity, and celebrating the region's orchard history. They offer a dazzling array of seasonal fruits and handcrafted products with an artisanal touch.

products.name: Hudson Valley Heritage Apples
products.description: A diverse selection of rare and heirloom apples, ranging from tart to sweet, with unique textures and colors. These apples are beloved for eating fresh, baking, and cider making.

products.name: Old Orchard Apple Butter
products.description: Slow-cooked apple butter with a velvety texture and warm spices. Spread it on toast, swirl it into oatmeal, or use it as a pork glaze. Made with a blend of heritage apples.

products.name: Grandpa’s Concord Grape Jelly
products.description: Deep purple, sweet-tart jelly made using age-old family recipes and the collective's finest grapes. A breakfast staple and a favorite in peanut butter sandwich lore.

name: The Nutty Squirrel Grove
description: Hidden among the woods of Oregon, The Nutty Squirrel Grove is a small, organic nut orchard run by a group of friends who left city life behind. They specialize in tree nuts, focusing on sustainable harvesting, wildlife preservation, and quirky nut-themed farm events. Their products are beloved for their freshness, crunch, and flavor.

products.name: Squirrel’s Bounty Mixed Nuts
products.description: A crunchy, roasted mix of Oregon’s best hazelnuts, walnuts, almonds, and pecans. Perfect for snacking or gifting. Squirrels not included (but very interested).

products.name: Hazelnut Dream Butter
products.description: Silky-smooth, spreadable hazelnut butter made from freshly roasted nuts. Rich in flavor and creamy in texture—delicious on toast, fruit, or straight off the spoon.

products.name: Candied Walnut Crunch
products.description: Walnuts roasted with brown sugar and a hint of cinnamon, forming a sweet, addictive snack or salad topping. Local legend says they disappear faster than you can say 'squirrel!'

name: Pepper Patch Fireworks
description: In the heart of New Mexico, Pepper Patch Fireworks is a spicy, family-run enterprise specializing in chili peppers of every variety. The Alvarez family has built a reputation for cultivating both the fiery and the mild, celebrating the region’s rich chili heritage. Their products explode with flavor and color, adding zest to kitchens near and far.

products.name: Blazing Red Chili Powder
products.description: A potent blend of sun-dried, ground red chili peppers. Adds bold heat and earthy undertones to dishes—handle with care! Favorite among local chefs and daring home cooks.

products.name: Mild Green Chile Salsa
products.description: A fresh, piquant salsa made with roasted green chiles, tomatoes, onions, and lime. Great on tacos, eggs, or as a dip. All the flavor, less of the fire.

products.name: Sweet Heat Pepper Jelly
products.description: A vibrant jelly with a balance of sweetness and a slow-building spice from New Mexico peppers. Excellent with cheese platters or as a glaze for grilled meats.

name: Woolly Meadows Sheep Dairy
description: Located on the windswept hills of Vermont, Woolly Meadows Sheep Dairy is a family-owned producer of artisanal sheep milk cheeses and wool products. Their small flock grazes lush clover pastures, producing rich milk for delicate cheeses. The farm is also known for its natural wool products, supporting local knitters and fiber artists. Sustainability, animal welfare, and traditional craftsmanship are at the core of their philosophy.

products.name: Lamb’s Cloud Feta
products.description: A creamy, tangy sheep milk feta cheese, aged to perfection in small batches. Crumble over salads or enjoy with olives and crusty bread.

products.name: Shepherd’s Blanket Ricotta
products.description: Soft, fresh ricotta made daily from sheep milk. Mild and fluffy, perfect for lasagna, pancakes, or sweet desserts.

products.name: Woolly Handspun Yarn
products.description: Lustrous, lanolin-rich yarn spun from the wool of our own sheep. Beloved by knitters for its warmth and natural feel. Each skein tells the story of our Vermont pastures.

name: Rolling Oats Family Farm
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of northern Minnesota, Rolling Oats Family Farm is a third-generation farm specializing in hearty grains and wholesome oats. The Lundstrom family is committed to sustainable crop rotation, minimal tillage, and no-spray practices—perfect for those seeking pure, old-fashioned flavor in their morning bowl of oatmeal.

products.name: Classic Rolled Oats
products.description: These rolled oats are plump, hearty, and the perfect base for a wholesome breakfast. With a slightly nutty aroma and soft chew, they’re delicious hot or cold, and make excellent cookies or granola.

products.name: Steel-Cut Oats
products.description: Irish-style steel-cut oats with a robust texture and natural sweetness. Great for slow-cooked porridge or as a crunchy topping for casseroles.

products.name: Oat Bran Cereal
products.description: Finely milled oat bran rich in fiber and flavor. Perfect for heart-healthy breakfast bowls or to boost the nutritional punch in baked goods.

name: Sunny Acres Poultry Co-op
description: Based in the sun-drenched valleys of California’s Central Coast, Sunny Acres is a worker-owned cooperative focusing on free-range eggs, heritage chicken breeds, and humane farming. The cooperative’s open-air barns and hand-gathered eggs have made them a farmers’ market favorite for over a decade.

products.name: Golden Sunrise Eggs
products.description: Farm-fresh eggs with rich, golden yolks from heritage hens. Popular among bakers and breakfast lovers for their superior taste and naturally sturdy shells.

products.name: Pullet Paradise Eggs
products.description: First-lay eggs from young pullets—smaller but with extra-rich yolks, perfect for custards or luxurious scrambled eggs.

products.name: Egg White Cloud Meringue Mix
products.description: Dried egg whites for baking light-as-air meringues or adding a protein boost to smoothies. Excellent for making pavlova or angel food cake.

name: Red Barn Barley Collective
description: A small but mighty collective in eastern Oregon, Red Barn Barley is dedicated to preserving ancient and heirloom barley varieties. Their collective comprises several family farms working together to promote soil health and bring malty, nutty barley to regional brewers and home cooks alike.

products.name: Malted Barley Pearls
products.description: Perfect for craft brewing or hearty risottos, these pearls are gently malted for a sweet, toasty flavor. Adds depth to soups and salads.

products.name: Barley Flour
products.description: Milled from heirloom barley, this flour makes rich, slightly sweet breads and pancakes. A great way to add whole grain goodness to your baking.

products.name: Barley Berry Salad Mix
products.description: A ready-to-cook blend of barley berries and regional dried herbs. Chewy, nutty, and ideal for grain bowls or as a side dish.

name: The Laughing Lettuce Organic Farm
description: Located on Vancouver Island, Laughing Lettuce is a quirky, certified-organic vegetable farm with a focus on salad greens and crunchy, colorful veggies. Founded by former city dwellers who love puns and pesticide-free produce, they supply local cafes and food co-ops with the freshest greens imaginable.

products.name: Spring Fling Salad Mix
products.description: A vibrant medley of baby lettuces, spinach, and arugula, known for its crisp texture and peppery bite. Washed and ready to eat—just add your favorite dressing!

products.name: Rainbow Crunch Carrots
products.description: Heirloom carrots in purple, yellow, and orange, prized for their sweetness and visual appeal. Great for snacking or roasting.

products.name: Celery Groove Sticks
products.description: Juicy, crunchy celery stalks from old European varieties. Excellent for snacking or adding zing to soups and salads.

name: Buzzy Sisters Apiary
description: Run by twin sisters Martha and Elaine, this Vermont apiary is home to thousands of happy honeybees. The Buzzy Sisters are passionate about pollinator health and natural beekeeping, producing a range of honeys and bee products while supporting wildflower meadows throughout New England.

products.name: Wildflower Raw Honey
products.description: Unfiltered, unpasteurized honey bursting with the flavors of Vermont’s wildflowers. Enjoy on toast, in tea, or drizzled over yogurt.

products.name: Bee Pollen Crunch
products.description: Granulated bee pollen for smoothies or a healthful boost to breakfast bowls. Packed with protein, vitamins, and a floral tang. Not for the highly allergic!

products.name: Royal Jelly Revival
products.description: A rare treat—pure royal jelly, prized for its creamy texture and alleged health benefits. Traditionally reserved for queen bees, now available for humans (with caution).

name: Misty Meadows Goat Dairy
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont, Misty Meadows Goat Dairy is a third-generation family farm specializing in artisan goat cheese and other goat dairy delights. The Jenkins family prides themselves on their animal-first approach, giving their goats ample pasture and a natural, stress-free life. Their philosophy: 'Happy goats make the best cheese.'

products.name: Vermont Velvet Chevre
products.description: A smooth, tangy fresh goat cheese made from hand-milked goats. Perfect for spreading on crackers or tossing in a salad. A local favorite with a creamy finish and subtle grassy notes.

products.name: Herb Garden Feta
products.description: Crumbled goat feta infused with homegrown herbs—oregano, thyme, and basil. Crumbles beautifully over roasted veggies or Mediterranean salads.

products.name: Goat Milk Yogurt Parfait
products.description: Creamy goat milk yogurt layered with Vermont wildflower honey and crisp granola. A breakfast treat with a tangy twist and probiotic boost.

name: Green Thumb Veggie Collective
description: This urban cooperative in Portland, Oregon, brings together a community of small growers passionate about organic, seasonal vegetables. With an emphasis on soil health and local biodiversity, Green Thumb specializes in heirloom varieties and hard-to-find greens. Their weekly boxes deliver the harvest straight from city gardens to local tables.

products.name: Rainbow Heirloom Carrot Mix
products.description: A vibrant bundle of purple, orange, and yellow carrots—each with its own subtle sweetness. Crunchy and colorful for snacking or roasting.

products.name: Purple Majesty Potato Bag
products.description: Rich, deep purple potatoes prized for their antioxidant content and buttery texture. A hit in mashed potatoes or baked fries.

products.name: Spicy Microgreen Salad
products.description: An energizing blend of mustard, radish, and arugula microgreens. Perfect as a peppery salad topper or sandwich addition.

name: The Nutty Squirrel Orchard
description: Hidden in the Appalachian foothills, The Nutty Squirrel Orchard is a specialty tree nut farm run by the playful Squirrell family (yes, that's really their name!). They grow and hand-harvest a diverse range of nuts, focusing on sustainable agroforestry and wildlife-friendly practices. Expect quirky products and a sense of woodland whimsy.

products.name: Grandpa Squirrell’s Toasted Walnut Mix
products.description: A delicious roasted mix of English and black walnuts, lightly salted for snacking. Crunchy, earthy, and perfect for cheese boards.

products.name: Sweet Maple Pecan Butter
products.description: Creamy pecan spread blended with a touch of local maple syrup. Slather on toast, dollop on oatmeal, or just eat by the spoonful.

products.name: Rustic Apple Hazelnut Cake
products.description: Bakery-fresh apple cake studded with toasted hazelnuts, made with orchard apples and a family recipe. Moist, fragrant, and autumn in every bite.

name: Hudson Valley Heritage Grains
description: Dedicated to reviving traditional grains, Hudson Valley Heritage Grains is a mid-sized farm in upstate New York focused on landrace wheats, ancient rye, and regional corn. They mill on-site, stone-ground for home bakers and artisan breadmakers. Conservation and education are central to their mission.

products.name: Stone-Ground Red Fife Flour
products.description: Whole grain flour from heirloom Red Fife wheat, prized by artisan bakers for its nutty aroma and robust structure. Ideal for sourdough and rustic loaves.

products.name: Hudson Polenta Corn Grits
products.description: Coarse yellow corn grits perfect for creamy polenta or crunchy skillet cakes. Made from an old local variety with rich, buttery notes.

products.name: Heritage Rye Bread Mix
products.description: A home-baker’s mix of stone-milled rye and wheat flours—earthy, slightly sour, and rich in fiber. Just add water and yeast!

name: Sunset Pastures Free-Range Meats
description: Located on the sun-drenched plains of Kansas, Sunset Pastures is a regenerative ranch specializing in grass-fed beef and pasture-raised lamb. The Joyce family utilizes rotational grazing and low-stress animal handling to restore prairie ecosystems. Their meat is known for its rich flavor and ethical production.

products.name: Prairie Gold Grass-Fed Ribeye
products.description: A juicy, marbled ribeye steak with complex, beefy flavor from 100% grass-fed cattle. Perfect for grilling or pan-searing—taste the difference of open-range ranching!

products.name: Spring Lamb Chops
products.description: Tender young lamb chops, pasture-raised on wildflower meadows. Mild, succulent, and ideal for a quick sear with fresh rosemary.

products.name: Smoky Beef & Barley Sausage
products.description: Savory links made with grass-fed beef and whole barley, smoked over hickory for a robust, hearty bite. Great for summer grilling or winter stews.

name: Sunnybrook Free-Range Eggery
description: Nestled on the rolling hills of Iowa, Sunnybrook Free-Range Eggery is a third-generation family farm specializing in ethically raised chickens and high-quality eggs. Their hens roam freely in sun-dappled pastures, leading to eggs with vibrant yolks and robust flavors. The farm prides itself on sustainability and animal welfare, delivering fresh eggs to local markets and restaurants every morning.

products.name: Sunrise Yolkers Jumbo Eggs
products.description: These extra-large, golden-yolked eggs are collected daily from pasture-raised hens. Perfect for hearty breakfasts, fluffy omelets, and baking projects. The deep orange yolks are a favorite among top chefs for their rich flavor and superior texture.

products.name: Golden Afternoon Mayonnaise
products.description: A creamy, homemade-style mayonnaise crafted with fresh Sunnybrook eggs and locally pressed sunflower oil. Silky, tangy, and perfect for sandwiches and salads. Just like grandma used to make—if grandma had access to fresh eggs every morning.

name: Riverbend Apiaries & Honey Co-op
description: Located along Vermont's Winooski River, Riverbend Apiaries is a cooperative of beekeepers committed to biodiversity and pollinator health. The co-op produces a range of artisanal honeys from wildflower to buckwheat, with an emphasis on organic practices and sustainable land stewardship. They also support pollinator education and native plant restoration.

products.name: Wildflower Harmony Honey
products.description: A fragrant, golden honey harvested from bees pollinating local wildflowers. Notes of clover, a hint of thyme, and a mellow finish make this a favorite for toast, tea, or drizzling over cheese.

products.name: Bee Pollen Superboost Mix
products.description: A nutrient-packed blend of bee pollen grains, perfect for sprinkling on yogurt, oatmeal, or smoothies. Renowned among health enthusiasts, but a no-go for those with pollen sensitivities.

name: Big Muddy Catfish Collective
description: Down on the banks of the Mississippi, this quirky collective of small-scale fishers specializes in freshwater fish—especially catfish. The Big Muddy Catfish Collective is dedicated to sustainable fishing, river conservation, and introducing locals to the joys of Southern-style catfish cuisine.

products.name: Granddad's Fried Catfish Fillets
products.description: Tender, hand-breaded catfish fillets from the freshest river catch. Ideal for classic Southern fried fish dinners, po' boys, or tacos. A taste of the Delta delivered with every bite.

products.name: Delta Catfish Cakes
products.description: Savory catfish patties blended with fresh herbs and a secret seasoning mix. These cakes are perfect for brunch or as a unique burger alternative. Flaky, flavorful, and Mississippi-approved.

name: Oat & Ivy Organic Farmstead
description: A small, woman-owned farm in Oregon's Willamette Valley, Oat & Ivy specializes in certified organic oats and heirloom root vegetables. The farm is passionate about regenerative agriculture, crop rotation, and producing food that's as good for the earth as it is for the table.

products.name: Willamette Creamy Rolled Oats
products.description: Plump, organic oats slow-rolled for maximum creaminess. Perfect for porridge, overnight oats, or as a hearty addition to granola. A breakfast staple with a nutty aroma and soft bite.

products.name: Sunrise Heirloom Carrots
products.description: A rainbow blend of sweet, crunchy carrots cultivated from heirloom seeds. Delicious raw, roasted, or juiced. These carrots are as beautiful as they are nutritious—kids love their colors!

name: Shear Bliss Sheep Dairy
description: Perched on the breezy slopes of the Blue Ridge Mountains, Shear Bliss is a boutique sheep dairy known for small-batch cheeses and luxurious sheep's milk yogurts. The farm is committed to pasture-raised flocks, humane animal care, and hand-crafting products that showcase the unique flavor of sheep's milk.

products.name: Blue Ridge Feta Crumble
products.description: Tangy, creamy feta cheese made from 100% sheep's milk. Crumbled and packed for easy sprinkling on salads, pizzas, and Mediterranean dishes. A briny delight with a smooth finish.

products.name: Sheep's Milk Strawberry Yogurt
products.description: Rich, velvety yogurt blended with real strawberries for a luscious, fruity treat. Perfect for breakfast bowls or a healthy snack. This yogurt is as decadent as dessert!

name: Red Clover Dairy Cooperative
description: Red Clover Dairy Cooperative is a fourth-generation farmer-owned operation in Wisconsin, known for its lush green pastures and commitment to animal welfare. The co-op focuses on traditional and artisanal cow's milk dairy products, favoring small-batch techniques and local heritage breeds. Their philosophy: 'Happy cows, tastier cheese.'

products.name: Clover Blossom Cheddar
products.description: Aged for a full year, this cheddar has a sharp, creamy bite with nutty undertones. Perfect for snacking, sandwiches, or melting into a gooey grilled cheese.

products.name: Pasture Sweet Cream Butter
products.description: Slow-churned from the richest summer milk, this butter is silky, with floral notes thanks to the cows’ diverse diet of wildflowers and clover.

products.name: Old Barn Swiss Cheese
products.description: A classic Swiss with signature holes, aged in the original barn’s cellar for a sweet, nutty flavor and a hint of earthiness from the Wisconsin soil.

name: The Nutty Squirrel Orchard & Nut Farm
description: A quirky, family-run nut and fruit farm on the foothills of Oregon. The Nutty Squirrel started as an apple orchard but expanded into tree nuts after wild squirrels 'planted' the first walnut grove. They focus on sustainable, low-impact growing methods and maintain a strict 'no squirrel left behind' ethos.

products.name: Squirrel Stash Almonds
products.description: Roasted in small batches, these almonds have a delicate crunch and subtle sweetness, making them a favorite trail snack (for both hikers and the farm’s resident squirrels).

products.name: Apple Orchard Honeycrisp
products.description: Crisp, juicy apples with a perfect balance of tart and sweet. Picked at peak ripeness for maximum flavor. Great for snacking or baking.

products.name: Harvest Hazelnuts
products.description: Toasty, buttery hazelnuts harvested every fall and dry-cured for extra crunch. Excellent in desserts or eaten straight from the bag.

name: Green Thumb Urban Microgreens
description: Operating out of repurposed shipping containers in downtown Detroit, Green Thumb Urban Microgreens brings hyperlocal, organic greens to city restaurants and markets. They use hydroponics and LED lighting, focusing on sustainability and zero-waste growing methods. Their motto: 'Big flavor, tiny leaves, no carbon footprint.'

products.name: Spicy Radish Microgreens
products.description: Peppery and bold, radish microgreens add a zesty crunch to salads, tacos, and sandwiches. Packed with vitamins and grown without soil or pesticides.

products.name: Sunflower Shoots
products.description: Tender, nutty sunflower shoots with a satisfying snap. A favorite of chefs for garnishing and adding a mild, earthy flavor to dishes.

products.name: Pea Tendril Microgreens
products.description: Delicate tendrils with a mild, sweet pea flavor. Perfect for salads, stir-fries, or as a fresh topping on avocado toast.

name: Muddy Boots Heritage Pork Farm
description: Set in the rolling hills of Tennessee, Muddy Boots specializes in heritage-breed pork, raising their animals on open pasture with acorn foraging and plenty of mud puddles. This family farm is passionate about humane husbandry, slow growth, and flavor above all.

products.name: Hickory-Smoked Bacon Slabs
products.description: Thick-cut slabs of bacon from heritage hogs, smoked over local hickory. Rich, savory, and slightly sweet—just like breakfast should be.

products.name: Country Sage Pork Sausage
products.description: Hand-ground sausage with a blend of sage, black pepper, and a hint of maple syrup. Great for biscuits, gravy, or breakfast burritos.

name: Sunburst Berry Patch
description: A picturesque, organic berry farm perched along the sunny slopes of North Carolina’s Blue Ridge Mountains. Sunburst Berry Patch focuses on heirloom strawberries and blueberries, championing pollinator health and soil biodiversity. Their pick-your-own fields are a summer family tradition.

products.name: Heirloom Strawberry Pint
products.description: Bright red, intensely aromatic strawberries grown from pre-WWII varieties. Sweet, juicy, and perfect for snacking or shortcake.

products.name: Blueberry Morning Mix
products.description: A medley of three blueberry varieties, each providing a unique flavor burst. Excellent for cereals, muffins, or straight out of the box.

products.name: Berry Blossom Jam
products.description: A luscious, small-batch jam combining strawberries and blueberries in a sweet-tart spread. No artificial preservatives—just pure berry goodness.

name: Laughing Goat Creamery
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont, Laughing Goat Creamery is a small, family-run farm renowned for its playful herd of Nubian and Alpine goats. Founded by the Jensen family in 2003, their philosophy is centered on humane, pasture-based goat husbandry and creating unique, artisanal goat dairy products. All cheeses and yogurts are made in small batches, with a focus on quality and tradition.

products.name: Verdant Valley Goat Chevre
products.description: A fresh, tangy goat cheese with hints of lemon, perfect for spreading on crusty bread or topping salads. Crafted from morning milk and hand-ladled for a delicate texture. Locals love it as a pizza topping!

products.name: Garlic & Chive Goat Feta
products.description: A crumbly, salty feta infused with aromatic garlic and fresh-cut chives from the farm's herb garden. Wonderful in Greek salads or sprinkled on roasted vegetables.

products.name: Maple-Drizzle Goat Yogurt
products.description: Creamy goat’s milk yogurt sweetened with Vermont’s finest maple syrup. Silky, tangy, and just sweet enough for breakfast or dessert.

name: Rolling Thunder Wheat Collective
description: Deep in the heart of Kansas, Rolling Thunder Wheat Collective is a worker-owned, organic grain farm that focuses on sustainable, rotational agriculture. Established during the cooperative movement of the 1970s, they now supply local bakeries and micro-breweries with premium wheat and barley.

products.name: Prairie Gold Whole Wheat Flour
products.description: Stone-milled from heritage hard red wheat, this flour is prized for its nutty flavor and baking strength. Great for sourdoughs and hearty sandwich loaves.

products.name: Sunrise Barley Kernels
products.description: Plump, golden barley perfect for soups, salads, and homebrewing. Known for its sweet, grassy flavor and chewy texture.

products.name: Thunderbolt Sourdough Bread
products.description: Artisan bread with a crackling crust and open crumb, baked in partnership with local bakers. Made only from farm-grown wheat, wild starter, and water—the Kansas wind gives the sourdough its unique tang.

name: Hoppin’ Harvest Rabbitry
description: Located on the outskirts of Eugene, Oregon, Hoppin’ Harvest Rabbitry is a specialty farm devoted to heritage breed rabbits raised in expansive, humane enclosures. The farm is known for its educational tours for families and its growing line of all-natural rabbit products, both culinary and non-culinary.

products.name: Pasture-Raised Rabbit Stew Cuts
products.description: Tender, mild-flavored rabbit meat, hand-butchered and packaged for use in hearty stews and classic French dishes. A lean, sustainable alternative to chicken or pork.

products.name: Bunny-Soft Wool Pellets
products.description: Pellets made from rabbit wool, ideal as a garden mulch or compost booster. Earth-friendly and gentle on sensitive plants. (Caution for those allergic to animal hair!)

name: Spicy Roots Organic Farm
description: Just outside San Antonio, Spicy Roots Organic Farm is a vibrant, women-owned producer specializing in chili peppers, root vegetables, and herbs. The farm prides itself on soil health, water conservation, and the fiery flavors of South Texas.

products.name: Firecracker Chili Blend
products.description: A mix of dried cayenne, jalapeño, and habanero peppers, ground for easy use in rubs, stews, or chili oil. Brings the heat to any Tex-Mex feast!

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Medley
products.description: Sweet and colorful heirloom carrots in purple, orange, and yellow. Crisp and juicy for snacking, roasting, or grating into salads. Kids love them for lunchboxes!

name: Old Orchard Apiaries
description: A third-generation beekeeping family in upstate New York, Old Orchard Apiaries manages over 300 hives nestled among wildflower meadows and apple orchards. They are stewards of pollinator health and produce an array of raw honeys and bee products, all with a focus on sustainability and education.

products.name: Wildflower Raw Honey
products.description: Unfiltered, golden honey with floral notes of clover, goldenrod, and apple blossom. Great for sweetening tea or drizzling on toast—each batch reflects the season’s unique blooms.

products.name: Bee Pollen Power Mix
products.description: A blend of pollen grains collected by the bees, packed with proteins and antioxidants. Popular as a smoothie boost or sprinkled on yogurt. (Warning: potent allergen for some!)

products.name: Comb Honey Slices
products.description: Honey straight from the hive, still in the waxy comb. Chewy, sweet, and rich in flavor—excellent on cheese platters or as a natural candy.

name: Sunpatch Strawberry Acres
description: Nestled in the heart of California’s Central Valley, Sunpatch Strawberry Acres is a family-owned operation run by three generations of the Alvarez family. They have dedicated their rich, loamy soil to the cultivation of strawberries and a handful of other summer fruits, focusing on sustainable growing and hand-picking techniques. Their philosophy is rooted in flavor and freshness, always putting taste above shelf-life. Every spring, the farm hosts a Strawberry Festival that draws visitors from far and wide.

products.name: Sunpatch Sweet Pick Strawberries
products.description: Bursting with juice, these hand-picked strawberries are renowned for their deep red color and intense, sweet flavor. Enjoy them fresh, bake them into shortcakes, or turn them into homemade jam!

products.name: Farmstand Strawberry Jam
products.description: A tradition for over 40 years, this jam is made in small batches with just strawberries, sugar, and a squeeze of lemon. Perfect for toast, yogurt, or as a cake filling.

name: Crimson Clover Bean Collective
description: Crimson Clover Bean Collective is a worker-owned cooperative in Iowa dedicated to sustainable legume farming. Specializing in heirloom beans and pulses, the collective experiments with crop rotation and soil-building practices to deliver both classic and uncommon varieties. Their commitment to biodiversity and soil health is matched only by their inventive recipes shared with CSA members each season.

products.name: Speckled Pinto Pantry Beans
products.description: A hearty pantry staple, these pinto beans are famous for their creamy texture and nutty flavor. Perfect for chilis, burritos, or as a protein-rich salad topping.

products.name: Heirloom Chickpea Hummus Kit
products.description: Everything you need to make ultra-creamy hummus at home—dried chickpeas, farm-grown garlic, and spice blend included. Just add olive oil and blend!

name: Wooly Meadows Sheep Farm
description: Located in the Scottish Highlands, Wooly Meadows Sheep Farm has been shepherded by the MacGregor family for over a century. They specialize in both heritage sheep breeds for wool and small-batch, artisanal sheep dairy. Their sheep graze freely on wildflower meadows, contributing to the distinct flavor of their cheeses and the softness of their wool. Wooly Meadows is famous for its humane animal husbandry and old-world craftsmanship.

products.name: Heather Blossom Sheep Cheese
products.description: A semi-soft sheep’s milk cheese with floral notes from the wild heather pastures. Creamy, tangy, and perfect on a cracker or melted on roasted veggies.

products.name: Wooly Meadows Handspun Yarn
products.description: Natural, lanolin-rich yarn handspun from the farm’s heritage flocks. Ideal for cozy sweaters and crafts, with a subtle wildflower scent.

name: Big Blue Lake Fishery
description: Big Blue Lake Fishery is a family-run operation on the shores of Minnesota’s largest natural lake. They specialize in sustainable freshwater fish, using responsible netting and restocking methods to protect native species. The fishery offers both whole fish and ready-to-cook fillets, supplying local restaurants and a bustling weekend fish market. Educational tours promote aquatic conservation and ethical fishing practices.

products.name: Fresh-Caught Walleye Fillets
products.description: Lean, mild, and flaky, these fillets are perfect for pan-frying, grilling, or fish tacos. Big Blue Lake’s walleye is prized for its clean flavor and tender texture.

products.name: Smoked Lake Whitefish
products.description: Brined and slow-smoked over alder wood, these fillets have a rich, savory flavor highlighted by a touch of sweetness. Ideal for bagels, salads, or snacking straight from the package.

name: The Nutty Nomad Orchard
description: The Nutty Nomad Orchard is an unconventional, mobile nut and fruit orchard based in the Pacific Northwest. Founded by a group of adventurous horticulturists, they plant and tend groves on leased and shared lands, focusing on rare and heritage nut trees. Their unique model supports local communities and preserves biodiversity. Beyond nuts, they experiment with fruit-nut hybrids and wild foraged edibles.

products.name: Wild Wanderer Hazelnuts
products.description: These raw hazelnuts are hand-gathered from restored woodlands. Rich and buttery, they’re delicious in baking or as a snack.

products.name: Nomad’s Trail Mix
products.description: A blend of orchard-grown hazelnuts, pecans, dried apples, and wild berries. The ultimate snack for hikers and adventurers.

name: Rolling Pastures Dairy Cooperative
description: Nestled in the lush hills of Vermont, Rolling Pastures Dairy Cooperative is a multi-generational, family-run operation founded in 1978. With a strong commitment to animal welfare, sustainable grazing, and local community, their cows and goats roam free and are treated like family. The coop specializes in small-batch, artisanal dairy products with a focus on both classic and innovative offerings.

products.name: Creamline Whole Milk
products.description: Rich, non-homogenized whole milk with a layer of cream on top—perfect for coffee, baking, or simply sipping chilled. The flavor reflects the lush, grassy pastures where the cows graze.

products.name: Vermont Maple Yogurt
products.description: Tangy, creamy yogurt sweetened with local Vermont maple syrup. Ideal for breakfast or as a dessert with granola.

products.name: Goat’s Milk Feta
products.description: A crumbly, salty cheese made from free-ranging goat milk. Great in salads, pastas, or as a snack. Made with age-old techniques brought from the Mediterranean.

products.name: Curd Nerd Cheddar
products.description: Aged sharp cheddar with a nutty, slightly tangy finish. Perfect for cheese boards, grilled cheese, or melting over casseroles.

name: Sunny Roots Vegetable Collective
description: Based in California’s Central Valley, Sunny Roots Vegetable Collective unites several small family farmers to grow and share diverse, organic vegetables. With a focus on heirloom varieties and soil regeneration techniques, the collective is known for its vibrant, flavorful produce and dedication to biodiversity.

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Medley
products.description: A colorful mix of purple, orange, yellow, and white carrots. Sweet, earthy, and crisp—great for roasting or raw snacking.

products.name: Golden Beet Bunch
products.description: Earthy, sweet golden beets with tender greens attached. Excellent roasted, pickled, or grated raw into salads.

products.name: Garlic Scape Pesto
products.description: A zesty, green pesto made from young garlic shoots and sunflower seeds. Perfect stirred into pasta or spread on toast.

name: Feather & Flap Poultry Farm
description: Located on the windswept plains of Kansas, Feather & Flap is run by the energetic Nguyen family. Specializing in pasture-raised poultry and eggs, they pride themselves on humane practices, open-air coops, and innovative, farm-fresh egg products. The farm is also a local advocate for allergy awareness in food labeling.

products.name: Golden Yolk Eggs
products.description: Pasture-raised eggs with deep yellow yolks. Rich-tasting and perfect for all your baking and breakfast needs. Fans swear they make the fluffiest omelets.

products.name: Chicken Sausage Links
products.description: Savory, hand-crafted sausages with farm herbs and a touch of black pepper. Ideal for breakfast or grilling season.

products.name: Featherlight Angel Food Cake
products.description: Super-fluffy angel food cake made with extra egg whites from the farm’s eggs, delivering a melt-in-your-mouth texture.

name: The Humble Legume Project
description: Located in the heart of Ontario’s farm belt, The Humble Legume Project is a cooperative dedicated to sustainable bean and pulse farming. They support soil health, reduce chemical inputs, and preserve rare heirloom varieties. Their mission: to make legumes delicious, accessible, and central to modern diets.

products.name: Heritage Chickpea Hummus
products.description: Silky, rich hummus made with heritage chickpeas and a hint of lemon. The nutty, earthy spread pairs perfectly with veggies, pita, or as a sandwich base.

products.name: Scarlet Lentil Stew Kit
products.description: A warming, ready-to-cook kit featuring vibrant red lentils, dried herbs, and farm-grown aromatics. Just add water for a hearty, protein-packed meal.

products.name: Crispy Falafel Bites
products.description: Golden-brown, crunchy falafel balls made with a blend of chickpeas and broad beans. Perfect for wraps, salads, or snacking.

name: Hop & Vine Heritage Acres
description: Situated amid Washington State’s rolling hills, Hop & Vine Heritage Acres is a multi-generational specialty farm focusing on rare grapes and heirloom hops. Established in 1912, the family has revived once-forgotten varietals and believes in hands-on cultivation and minimal intervention. Their produce fuels both local breweries and small-batch winemakers.

products.name: Heirloom Cascade Hops
products.description: Classic aromatic hops with notes of citrus and pine. Coveted by local craft brewers for their unique complexity and robust bitterness.

products.name: Violet Pearl Grapes
products.description: Rare, sweet-tart grapes with a dark purple hue. Bursting with flavor, perfect for snacking or home winemaking. These grapes are a nod to the family's original vineyard stock.

products.name: Harvest Gold Grape Jelly
products.description: Sun-ripened grapes transformed into a golden, luscious jelly—ideal for toast, thumbprint cookies, or as a cheese board accompaniment.

name: Woolly Wonders Sheep Farm
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont, Woolly Wonders is a fourth-generation family farm specializing in everything sheep: from pasture-raised lamb to rich sheep's milk cheeses and artisanal wool. The family prides themselves on heritage breeds and sustainable, low-impact farming. Their sheep graze lush meadows, and the farm is a popular destination for school trips and knitters alike.

products.name: Ewe's Dream Feta
products.description: A crumbly, tangy feta made from 100% sheep's milk. Perfect for salads, mezze platters, or crumbling over roasted vegetables. Distinctly creamy with a bright, briny finish.

products.name: Woolly Wonders Ricotta
products.description: Soft, fluffy ricotta cheese crafted from fresh sheep's milk. Excellent for pastries, lasagna, or simply spread on toast with honey.

products.name: Hand-Spun Sheep Wool Yarn
products.description: Luxuriously soft and naturally insulating, this undyed yarn comes from the farm's happiest sheep. Perfect for winter hats and cozy scarves.

products.name: Classic Lamb Chops
products.description: Tender, grass-fed lamb chops, ideal for grilling or roasting. Known locally for their delicate flavor and melt-in-the-mouth texture.

name: Crimson Orchard Collective
description: Located in the heart of Washington State, Crimson Orchard is a cooperative of multigenerational fruit growers committed to eco-friendly practices and rare apple and berry varieties. They focus on biodiversity, pollinator habitats, and organic production, supplying local markets and cideries.

products.name: Ruby Blush Apples
products.description: A crisp, sweet-tart apple developed for maximum crunch and vibrant color. Great for snacking or baking. Fun fact: this variety is a favorite among local cider makers.

products.name: Sunrise Strawberry Jam
products.description: Small-batch, low-sugar jam bursting with the flavor of just-picked strawberries. Perfect on toast, yogurt, or in thumbprint cookies.

products.name: Blushing Cider
products.description: A refreshing, slightly dry cider crafted from a blend of heirloom apples. Pairs wonderfully with sharp cheese and salty snacks.

products.name: Gala's Garden Apple Sauce
products.description: Smooth, naturally sweet applesauce made from a mix of tart and sweet apples. No sugar added—just pure orchard goodness.

name: The Spicy Patch
description: A quirky, family-run specialty farm in New Mexico dedicated to all things hot pepper. The Spicy Patch cultivates dozens of chili varieties, from mild Anaheims to scorching Carolina Reapers. Their philosophy: flavor first, heat second (but lots of both!).

products.name: Ghost Fire Hot Sauce
products.description: An ultra-hot sauce featuring ghost peppers and a blend of farm-grown tomatoes and garlic. Not for the faint of heart—try it on tacos, eggs, or daredevil chili challenges.

products.name: Mild Mellow Salsa
products.description: A zesty, approachable salsa made with roasted Anaheim peppers, tomatoes, and sweet onions. Family friendly with just a hint of heat.

products.name: Smoky Chipotle Powder
products.description: A deep, smoky powder from slow-smoked chipotle peppers—perfect for grilling rubs, chili, or adding depth to stews.

name: Hoppy Hare Rabbitry
description: On the outskirts of Madison, Wisconsin, Hoppy Hare is a small specialty farm focused on ethical, pasture-based rabbit breeding for both fiber and meat. The farm supports local youth ag programs and is famous for its angora wool and tender, lean rabbit meat.

products.name: Angora Cloud Yarn
products.description: Feathery-soft, ethically harvested angora yarn. Naturally white, perfect for luxurious knitting or felting projects.

products.name: Pasture-Raised Rabbit Loins
products.description: Mild, delicately flavored rabbit loins, ideal for grilling or pan-searing. Lean and high in protein, loved by foodies seeking something different.

name: Sunbeam Sunflower Estate
description: A sprawling organic farm in Kansas, Sunbeam Sunflower focuses on sustainable sunflower seed and oil production, with a side of pollinator-friendly wildflower honey. Their eco-philosophy: feed the world, feed the bees, and leave the soil better than they found it.

products.name: Golden Sunflower Oil
products.description: Cold-pressed organic oil with a subtle nutty taste, ideal for salads and sautéing. Rich in vitamin E and omega fatty acids.

products.name: Sunbeam Seed Crunch
products.description: Lightly salted, roasted sunflower seeds—perfect for snacking or tossing on salads. A farm-favorite lunchbox treat!

products.name: Wildflower Bee Honey
products.description: Raw, unfiltered honey collected from bees that pollinate the estate's wildflowers. Floral, bright, and a favorite among local bakers.

name: Moo & Brew Dairy
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Wisconsin, Moo & Brew Dairy is a fourth-generation family farm dedicated to sustainable and humane dairy practices. Famous among locals for their happy, pasture-raised Holsteins and their quirky farm café, the dairy believes in minimal processing and maximum flavor. They recently expanded to offer small-batch cheese and yogurt, all made from cows who are practically family.

products.name: Barnyard Gold Whole Milk
products.description: Fresh, creamy whole milk with a naturally sweet finish, bottled within 24 hours of milking. Perfect for morning cereal or a comforting glass at night.

products.name: Udderly Smooth Greek Yogurt
products.description: Thick, tangy yogurt made with live cultures and a touch of nostalgia. Delicious with local honey or fresh fruit.

products.name: Cheese Curds (The Squeaky Batch)
products.description: The Midwest classic! These pillowy, squeaky cheese morsels are a regional obsession and perfect for snacking.

name: Nutty by Nature Cooperative
description: A group of small-scale nut growers from Northern California, Nutty by Nature focuses on sustainable, pesticide-free nut orchards. The cooperative is committed to biodiversity and offers a wide range of tree nuts. They've also become well known for their irreverent social media presence and nutty puns.

products.name: Almond Overboard Butter
products.description: Creamy, lightly roasted almond butter that spreads like a dream. Made from single-origin almonds harvested by hand.

products.name: Walnut Wonderland Mix
products.description: A crunchy, earthy snack mix featuring fresh walnuts, pecans, and a touch of sea salt. Great as a salad topper or by the handful.

products.name: Hazel Hysteria Roasted Nuts
products.description: Rich, toasty hazelnuts with a hint of caramelization. Perfect for desserts or nut lovers' midnight cravings.

name: Crusty Loaf Organic Breads
description: Based in the heart of Vermont, Crusty Loaf is an artisanal bakery and grain farm specializing in heritage wheat and rye varieties. Their fully organic operation is committed to using stone-milled flours and traditional fermentation. Crusty Loaf's long-fermented loaves are a staple at local markets and their community bread subscription is legendary.

products.name: Vermont Sourdough Classic
products.description: A chewy, tangy sourdough loaf made with wild yeast and heirloom wheat. The flavor is developed over 36 hours for the perfect crust and crumb.

products.name: Whole Rye Robust
products.description: Deeply flavorful rye bread with a dense texture and malty finish. Great for sandwiches or slathered with butter.

products.name: Sunflower Oat Hearth Bread
products.description: Hearty round loaf featuring toasted sunflower seeds and Vermont oats. Crunchy outside, soft inside—perfect for breakfast or soups.

name: Green Feather Quail Farm
description: A specialty family farm on the outskirts of Portland, Oregon, Green Feather raises Japanese quail for gourmet eggs and meat. Their operation is pasture-based, and their birds enjoy a diet of local grains and greens. Known for their eco-friendly approach, they've become a go-to for Portland chefs seeking unique, high-protein eggs.

products.name: Spotty Shell Quail Eggs
products.description: Delicate, speckled quail eggs prized for their creamy yolks and rich flavor. Ideal for canapés, ramen, or adventurous breakfasts.

products.name: Quail Rillettes
products.description: A rustic, French-inspired spread made from slow-cooked quail. Savory, rich and perfect for baguette slices or crackers.

name: The Happy Hive Apiary
description: Founded by two retired teachers with a passion for pollinators, The Happy Hive shines as a small but mighty organic apiary in Georgia. Their bees forage on wildflowers and clover, creating unique, hyperlocal honey products. The Happy Hive is also dedicated to community education about pollinators and sustainable beekeeping.

products.name: Wildflower Buzz Raw Honey
products.description: Unfiltered raw honey with floral notes and a golden hue. Sourced from happy, healthy bees on pesticide-free fields.

products.name: Bee Pollen Vitality Blend
products.description: A blend of bee pollen granules—a superfood for smoothies or yogurt. Warning: not for the highly allergic!

products.name: Comb-in-the-Jar Honey
products.description: Chunky, aromatic honeycomb suspended in pure, raw honey. Chewy, sweet, and a conversation starter for any cheese board.

name: Sunny Patch Organic Veg Farm
description: Sunny Patch is a small-scale, family-run organic vegetable farm nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont. Sarah and Marcus, former city-dwellers turned farmers, are passionate about regenerative agriculture and community-supported farming. Their focus is on colorful heirloom vegetables, sustainable growing practices, and innovative veggie snacks. Every season, they introduce new varieties to surprise their CSA members and local chefs.

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Medley
products.description: A crunchy and sweet mix of purple, yellow, orange, and white heirloom carrots. Perfect for roasting or snacking. Grown with love, and no chemical pesticides. Fun fact: different colors mean different antioxidants!

products.name: Heirloom Tomato Snack Packs
products.description: Juicy cherry and grape tomatoes of every color, hand-packed for lunchboxes or snacking. These tomatoes burst with sun-ripened flavor and are a favorite among local kids.

products.name: Spicy Garlic Scape Pesto
products.description: A bold, tangy pesto made from fresh garlic scapes, basil, sunflower seeds, and olive oil. Delicious on pasta or sandwiches. No nuts or cheese, but packs a flavorful punch!

name: Woolly Acres Sheep Farm
description: Located on the wild moors of Yorkshire, Woolly Acres is a multi-generational sheep farm famous for their sustainable wool products and artisan sheep cheeses. The farm, run by the O'Malley clan, focuses on low-impact grazing and natural dyes for wool. They've recently expanded into cheese-making and lanolin-rich skincare.

products.name: Shepherd’s Gold Aged Sheep Cheese
products.description: A nutty, firm sheep’s cheese aged for 12 months in stone cellars. Excellent on crackers or melted over potatoes. Made in small batches from grass-fed sheep.

products.name: Woolly Acres Lanolin Balm
products.description: All-natural, deeply moisturizing balm crafted from purified sheep wool lanolin and Yorkshire lavender. A favorite among knitters and outdoor workers.

name: The Funky Fungi Collective
description: Deep in Oregon's misty forests, The Funky Fungi Collective is a unique mushroom cooperative made up of nature enthusiasts and mycologists. They cultivate gourmet and medicinal mushrooms, experiment with mushroom-based snacks, and run foraging workshops. Their philosophy: 'Let mushrooms save the world!'

products.name: Forest Medley Mushroom Box
products.description: A chef's sampler of shiitake, lion’s mane, oyster, and chestnut mushrooms, freshly harvested and perfect for stir-fries or risottos. These beauties are grown on hardwood logs and organic straw.

products.name: Truffle-Infused Mushroom Jerky
products.description: Umami-packed jerky made from king oyster mushrooms, marinated in truffle oil, tamari, and smoked paprika. A vegan snack for adventurous palates.

name: Feather & Cluck Heritage Poultry
description: A quirky, mid-sized heritage poultry farm in rural Georgia, Feather & Cluck specializes in rare chicken breeds and pasture-raised eggs.
