The farm, founded by siblings Gina and Tom after inheriting their grandparents' land, prides itself on bird welfare and vibrant yolks. Visitors are greeted by a chorus of clucks and the occasional wandering rooster.

products.name: Golden-Yolk Pasture Eggs
products.description: Eggs from free-ranging heritage hens, collected daily. Yolks are richly colored thanks to a varied diet of greens and bugs. Baked goods and breakfasts never tasted so good!

products.name: Heritage Roaster Chicken
products.description: Whole, pasture-raised heritage chickens, known for deep flavor and firm texture. Perfect for roasting, with crispy skin and juicy meat. Each bird is traceable to its flock.

name: Apple Blossom Orchards
description: Sprawled across the gentle hills of Washington State, Apple Blossom Orchards is a family business in its fifth generation. They grow over 25 varieties of apples and pears, craft small-batch ciders, and make old-fashioned apple butter. Their motto: 'Branching out since 1890.'

products.name: Honeycrisp Apple Cider
products.description: A refreshing, lightly sparkling cider pressed from hand-picked Honeycrisp apples. Tart, sweet, and a true taste of fall in every sip. Unfiltered for maximum flavor.

products.name: Classic Apple Butter
products.description: Slow-cooked apple butter made from a secret blend of heritage apples, cinnamon, and a hint of clove. Spread on toast, swirl into oatmeal, or use as a sweet glaze for pork.

products.name: Pear & Ginger Preserves
products.description: A sweet-tangy preserve made with Bartlett pears and a kick of fresh ginger. Perfect on scones or with cheese. Made in tiny copper kettles!

name: Moo & Brew Dairy Co.
description: Founded by the O'Sullivan siblings in rural Wisconsin, Moo & Brew Dairy Co. is a mid-sized family-operated farm known for its pasture-raised cows and creative approach to dairy. Their philosophy is simple: happy cows make tastier milk and cheese. In recent years, they’ve expanded into farm-brewed milk stouts and offer dairy tours for curious visitors.

products.name: Golden Sunrise Whole Milk
products.description: Rich, creamy, and pasteurized at low temperatures, this milk comes from grass-fed cows and is renowned for its natural sweetness. Perfect for cereal, coffee, or a cold glass on a hot day.

products.name: Cheddar Curds of Joy
products.description: Fresh, squeaky cheese curds made daily and best enjoyed straight from the bag or tossed atop a plate of fries for a Midwest classic.

products.name: Stout-Infused Cheddar
products.description: Aged cheddar with swirls of house-brewed milk stout, offering malty undertones and a unique finish. Great for cheese boards or melting on burgers.

products.name: Creamline Chocolate Milk
products.description: Ultra-creamy chocolate milk made with real cocoa and no artificial sweeteners. A nostalgic treat for kids and adults alike.

name: Blue River Trout Collective
description: Nestled alongside the Blue River in Oregon, this cooperative of small-scale aquaculture enthusiasts specializes in sustainable trout and freshwater fish. They believe in clean water, natural feed, and minimizing environmental impact. The collective has become a go-to for local restaurants seeking ultra-fresh fish.

products.name: River-Fresh Rainbow Trout
products.description: Delicate, flaky fillets with a mild, buttery flavor, perfect pan-seared or grilled. Raised with pure spring water and a natural diet.

products.name: Smoked Brook Trout Spread
products.description: A creamy, smoky spread made from house-smoked brook trout blended with herbs and a touch of lemon. Ideal for crackers or rustic bread.

name: Granny Dot’s Heritage Grain Mill
description: Operating in the rolling hills of northeastern Kansas, Granny Dot’s is a women-owned, multigenerational grain farm and stone mill. They focus on rare and heritage grains grown using regenerative practices. Their philosophy: “Good bread begins with good soil and even better stories.”

products.name: Red Wheat Flour (Stoneground)
products.description: Nutty, robust flour ground from heirloom red wheat. Ideal for rustic breads and hearty pancakes.

products.name: Spelt & Rye Sourdough Mix
products.description: An artisan blend for sourdough lovers, featuring ancient spelt and earthy rye for robust flavor and chewy crumb.

products.name: Buckwheat Breakfast Pancake Mix
products.description: Gluten-friendly, nutty buckwheat pancakes from non-wheat buckwheat, perfect for a hearty start. Note: not related to wheat but still allergenic for some.

name: Prickle & Squeak Cactus Co.
description: Based in southern Arizona, Prickle & Squeak is a quirky family-owned specialty farm focusing on edible cacti and desert succulents. Run by the Martinez family, they champion drought resilience, biodiversity, and inventive flavors for adventurous chefs and home cooks.

products.name: Nopalito Salad Cuts
products.description: Tender, tangy pads of young prickly pear cactus, pre-cut and ready for salads, tacos, or stir-fries. A classic in southwestern cuisine.

products.name: Prickly Pear Syrup
products.description: Vivid magenta syrup bursting with sweet-tart flavor, made from the fruit of the prickly pear cactus. Drizzle on pancakes, cocktails, or ice cream.

products.name: Cactus Flower Honey (Desert Blend)
products.description: A rare, subtly floral honey harvested from bees foraging on cactus blossoms. Limited quantity and highly prized by local chefs.

name: Nutty Professors Orchard & Apiary
description: Located in the rolling hills of Vermont, Nutty Professors is part science lab, part tree nut orchard, and part bee haven. Run by two retired biologists, this medium-scale farm specializes in cold-hardy tree nuts and artisan honey, blending curiosity with conservation. Their mission: “Grow nuts, save bees, and never stop learning.”

products.name: Toasted Hazelnuts (Vermont Grown)
products.description: Crunchy, aromatic hazelnuts, roasted for maximum flavor. Perfect for snacking, baking, or as a topping for yogurt and salads.

products.name: Maple-Infused Walnut Butter
products.description: Smooth, nutty walnut butter with a hint of local maple syrup. Spread on toast or swirl into oatmeal for a decadent breakfast.

products.name: Beech-Nut & Wildflower Honey Granola
products.description: Hearty granola featuring crunchy beech nuts and the orchard’s raw wildflower honey—a breakfast that’s both brainy and delicious.

name: Sunny Patch Veggie Collective
description: Sunny Patch Veggie Collective is an organic urban farming cooperative based in the Pacific Northwest. Founded by a group of city dwellers turned green thumbs, they specialize in heirloom and specialty vegetables grown in raised beds and rooftop gardens. Their philosophy centers on sustainable, small-batch farming, biodiversity, and educating urban communities about fresh produce.

products.name: Rainbow Crunch Carrots
products.description: A blend of purple, yellow, and orange heirloom carrots with extra sweetness and a snappy crunch. Perfect for snacking, roasting, or adding color to salads. Developed from heritage seeds for maximum flavor and fun.

products.name: Sunrise Cherry Tomatoes
products.description: Sweet, bite-sized cherry tomatoes bursting with flavor. Ideal for fresh eating, salads, or roasting. Their unique color gradient—from gold to red—makes them a darling at the farmer’s market.

products.name: Garlic Zing Scapes
products.description: Tender garlic scapes harvested at peak freshness, offering a mild garlicky snap. Sauté, grill, or blend into a zesty pesto. Fun fact: Scapes are the flower stalks of garlic plants, prized by chefs for their flavor and versatility.

name: Rolling Field Oatery
description: Nestled in the gentle hills of Manitoba, Rolling Field Oatery is a family-run farm specializing in premium oats and ancient grains. The farm was started by the Jensen family in the 1970s and has recently expanded into gluten-friendly varieties. They're passionate about soil health, crop rotation, and making mornings heartier, one bowl at a time.

products.name: Harvest Gold Rolled Oats
products.description: Hearty, chewy rolled oats milled fresh for breakfast lovers. Great for overnight oats, granola, or classic oatmeal. Sourced from lovingly tended fields and minimally processed.

products.name: Maple Sunrise Oat Granola
products.description: Crunchy granola with toasted oats and a hint of real maple syrup, perfect with yogurt or as a snack on the go. Developed from a family recipe passed down through generations.

name: Little Feather Poultry Farm
description: Little Feather Poultry Farm is a small, pasture-based farm in rural Georgia specializing in heritage chicken and duck breeds. Run by the Nguyen family, they raise birds humanely on open pasture, focusing on flavor, animal welfare, and regenerative land practices. Their eggs are favorites with local chefs and bakers.

products.name: Pasture-Raised Chicken Eggs
products.description: Rich, golden-yolked eggs from happy, foraging hens. Perfect for breakfast, baking, or gourmet dishes. Each dozen is hand-gathered and packed with care.

products.name: Duck Egg Dozen
products.description: Large, creamy duck eggs with extra protein and a luxurious texture—ideal for pastries and custards. Sourced from heritage Khaki Campbell and Pekin ducks.

name: Wild Orchard Goatery
description: Set against the rolling hills of Vermont, Wild Orchard Goatery is an artisanal goat farm producing small-batch cheeses and body care products. Founded by a pair of former city dwellers seeking a quieter life, the farm is known for its playful goats, wildflower pastures, and eco-friendly philosophy.

products.name: Sunrise Chevre Log
products.description: A tangy, creamy goat cheese log rolled in garden herbs. Spreadable, bright, and perfect for cheese boards or salads. Made with milk from pasture-raised goats.

products.name: Goat Milk & Lavender Soap
products.description: Handcrafted soap blending fresh goat milk with calming lavender. Gentle for most skin types, though not for those with milk sensitivities.

name: Red Barn Sunflower Acres
description: Located on the windswept plains of Kansas, Red Barn Sunflower Acres is a mid-sized specialty farm with a passion for all things sunflower. Founded by three sisters, the farm has become a regional hot spot for sunflower oil, seeds, and agritourism events. Their mission: spread sunshine, snacks, and sustainable agriculture.

products.name: Golden Heart Sunflower Seeds
products.description: Roasted sunflower seeds with a nutty, slightly salty crunch. Perfect as a healthy snack or salad topping. Grown and processed right on the farm for maximum freshness.

products.name: Sunshine Cold-Pressed Sunflower Oil
products.description: Light, golden sunflower oil cold-pressed for a subtle, nutty flavor. Excellent for sautéing, dressings, and baking. Bottled in glass to preserve freshness.

products.name: Sunflower Honey Mead
products.description: A lightly sparkling mead infused with nectar from the farm’s own sunflower fields. Floral, refreshing, and perfect for summer evenings.

name: Brambly Hedge Dairy
description: Nestled in the cool, misty valleys of Vermont, Brambly Hedge Dairy is a third-generation family-run operation famous for its pasture-raised cows and creamy, small-batch cheeses. Sustainability is at their core: cows graze on clover-rich meadows, and the dairy uses solar power for much of its processing. The farm believes in minimal intervention, letting the natural flavors of their milk shine through in every product.

products.name: Maple Grove Aged Cheddar
products.description: A sharp white cheddar aged for two years, with notes of sweet grass and a subtle hint of Vermont maple. Perfect for snacking, melting on burgers, or adding to a classic mac and cheese.

products.name: Misty Morning Brie
products.description: This soft, creamy brie is wrapped in a delicate rind and has earthy undertones, perfect on a crusty baguette or paired with apples. Crafted using traditional French techniques.

products.name: Farmhouse Yogurt
products.description: Thick, tangy yogurt made with whole Jersey cow milk, loved for its probiotic punch and velvety texture. Available plain or with local berry swirls.

products.name: Sunrise Ricotta
products.description: Fresh, fluffy ricotta that’s perfect for lasagna, pancakes, or spreading on toast with a drizzle of honey.

name: Spicy Roots Organic Collective
description: Spicy Roots is a dynamic, worker-owned farm cooperative in New Mexico dedicated to organic, hot-weather crops—especially chilies. Founded by a group of food-obsessed friends, the collective focuses on regenerative agriculture, soil health, and fiery flavors. Their chilies are hand-picked and sun-dried for maximum taste.

products.name: Firecracker Red Chile Powder
products.description: Bright red and intensely spicy, this powder is made from hand-picked New Mexican chilies, sun-dried and ground on site. Ideal for chili, tacos, and adding serious heat to any dish.

products.name: Smoky Chipotle Paste
products.description: A deeply smoky, thick paste made from slowly smoked chipotle peppers, perfect for marinating meats or adding a kick to your favorite sauces.

products.name: Zesty Jalapeño Salsa
products.description: Fresh jalapeños, onions, and cilantro combine for a tangy, spicy salsa that brings any taco night to life. Beware—it packs a punch!

name: Happy Hare Hopstead
description: Located on the rolling hills outside Portland, Oregon, Happy Hare Hopstead is an eco-friendly microfarm specializing in gourmet edible flowers and unusual root vegetables. The farm is run by an enthusiastic group of horticulturalists and—true to their name—a lively family of rabbits who keep the weeds down (and sometimes steal produce). Happy Hare is known for its whimsical approach to farming and delightfully unexpected crops.

products.name: Rainbow Radish Medley
products.description: A vibrant mix of heirloom radishes in purple, pink, and white, offering a mild peppery flavor and crisp crunch. Perfect for salads and snack platters. Grown with organic methods and hand-harvested at peak sweetness.

products.name: Edible Flower Confetti
products.description: A colorful blend of nasturtiums, violets, calendula, and borage—each petal bringing a unique flavor and floral aroma. Ideal for garnishing cakes, salads, and cocktails. All flowers are pesticide-free and safe to eat.

products.name: Honeyed Carrot Bunches
products.description: Sweet, petite carrots with a hint of honey-like flavor, perfect for roasting or dipping. These carrots are known to convert even the most reluctant vegetable eaters.

name: Bluff & Vine Heritage Orchard
description: On the sun-kissed slopes of Michigan’s fruit belt, Bluff & Vine Heritage Orchard is an old family estate, now run by siblings with a passion for rare apples and classic American grape varieties. The orchard’s mission is to preserve antique fruit varieties, offering nostalgic flavors and a living history lesson in every bite. They follow integrated pest management and no-spray practices whenever possible.

products.name: Heirloom Apple Cider
products.description: Cold-pressed from a blend of 19th-century apple varieties, this cider is crisp, tart, and slightly floral, with a flavor profile that changes each year based on the harvest.

products.name: Vintner’s Grape Jelly
products.description: A jewel-toned, fragrant jelly made from Concord and Niagara grapes, perfect for spreading on toast or pairing with cheese. Made in small batches for peak freshness.

products.name: Crispin’s Choice Apple Slices
products.description: Dried apple rings from the Crispin apple tree, chewy and sweet with a tart finish. Ideal as a lunchbox snack or a natural sweetener in oatmeal.

name: Pecan Prairie Patch
description: Deep in the heart of Texas, Pecan Prairie Patch is a specialty nut farm run by the quirky Wilkins family, who have turned pecan growing into an art—and a science! Their trees are over 60 years old and grow on rich, loamy soil. The Wilkins are champions of biodiversity, and their nuts are prized by bakers and chefs across the region.

products.name: Grandma Wilkins’ Roasted Pecans
products.description: Hand-shelled, lightly salted, and roasted to perfection. These pecans are buttery and sweet—a family recipe passed down for generations. Excellent on salads, oatmeal, or as a simple snack.

products.name: Texas Pecan Butter
products.description: A creamy, rich butter made entirely from freshly ground pecans and a pinch of sea salt. Spread on toast, it’s a taste of southern comfort.

products.name: Pecan Pie Magic Kit
products.description: Everything you need to make a classic southern pecan pie—includes shelled pecans, a secret spice blend, and old-school instructions. Just add eggs and syrup!

name: Sunbeam Quailery
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of central California, Sunbeam Quailery is a family-run farm specializing in free-range quail. The Martinez family began with a few birds as a hobby and quickly discovered the demand for gourmet quail eggs and delicate meats. They pride themselves on sustainable practices and supplying local chefs with top-quality quail products.

products.name: Golden Quail Eggs
products.description: Petite, speckled eggs with a richer flavor than chicken eggs. Perfect for salads, hors d'oeuvres, and gourmet breakfasts. Loved by foodies for their creamy texture and dainty size.

products.name: Herb-Marinated Quail
products.description: Tender quail marinated in farm-grown herbs, ready for roasting or grilling. A lean, flavorful alternative to chicken, ideal for special occasions or adventurous cooks.

name: Mighty Stalks Urban Farm Cooperative
description: Operating on converted city lots in Detroit, Mighty Stalks Urban Farm Cooperative is a collective of neighbors passionate about sustainable, hyper-local produce. They focus on celery, carrots, and other hearty vegetables, employing hydroponic and organic methods. Education and food justice are at the heart of their mission.

products.name: Crisp Celery Bunches
products.description: Extra crunchy, deeply green celery with a refreshing bite. Ideal for snacking, juicing, or soup bases. The urban terroir imparts a unique mineral tang.

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Medley
products.description: A vibrant mix of heirloom carrots—purple, yellow, and orange—each with subtly different sweet-earthy flavors. Great for roasting or raw munching.

products.name: Hydroponic Salad Mix
products.description: A chef favorite, this mix includes celery, carrot tops, and tender greens, harvested at peak freshness for maximum crunch and flavor.

name: Woolly Wonders Sheep Dairy
description: On the misty slopes of Vermont, Woolly Wonders Sheep Dairy is run by the enterprising O'Malley sisters. They specialize in sheep's milk cheeses and lanolin-based products, boasting a flock of pampered ewes and a commitment to regenerative grazing.

products.name: Sheep's Milk Feta
products.description: Salty, crumbly feta handmade from the morning's sheep milk. Excellent in Greek salads or melted atop roasted veggies. Slightly tangier than cow or goat feta.

products.name: Lanolin Hand Balm
products.description: A soothing balm made from pure sheep wool lanolin, perfect for rough farmhands and city dwellers alike. Moisturizes deeply—just beware if you're lanolin-sensitive!

name: Red Feather Poultry Ranch
description: A third-generation Oklahoma poultry ranch known for pasture-raised chickens and specialty eggs. The Red Feather family believes in happy hens and open fields, supplying eggs to local markets and bakeries. Their prize-winners are the deep-orange yolks and quirky blue eggs from their heritage breeds.

products.name: Farm-Fresh Brown Eggs
products.description: Classic brown-shelled eggs from pasture-raised hens, renowned for their vibrant yellow yolks and superior baking properties.

products.name: Blue Heirloom Eggs
products.description: A rare treat—blue-shelled eggs from Araucana hens! Prized by home chefs for their rich flavor and show-stopping color in baskets and bakes.

products.name: Chicken Feather Down Pillow
products.description: Ultra-soft pillows stuffed with cleaned, farm-fresh chicken feathers. Perfect for a dreamy night's sleep—unless you've got a feather allergy!

name: Sunset Sunflower Acres
description: On the sun-drenched plains of Kansas, this mid-sized family farm has turned fields of sunflowers into an art form. Sunset Sunflower Acres is famous for their cold-pressed sunflower oil, roasted seeds, and even edible flower petals. They welcome visitors every August to a sunflower maze extravaganza.

products.name: Golden Sunflower Oil
products.description: Expeller-pressed from their own sunflowers, this oil is rich, nutty, and perfect for dressings, sautéing, or baking. Locals swear it’s the secret to flaky pie crusts.

products.name: Salted Sunflower Seeds
products.description: Crunchy, roasted seeds with a sprinkle of sea salt—ideal for snacking or topping salads. Harvested at peak ripeness for maximum flavor.

products.name: Sunflower Petal Salad Garnish
products.description: Bright yellow petals, lightly sweet and slightly nutty, add color and subtle flavor to salads and desserts. A favorite among local chefs for edible flower creations.

name: Beetnik Underground Collective
description: Under the city streets of Portland, Beetnik Underground Collective grows vibrant beets, microgreens, and root vegetables in converted shipping containers using hydroponics and LED lighting. Run by a team of artists and former software engineers, their farm is as much a social experiment as an agricultural one.

products.name: Crimson Crunch Beets
products.description: Deep red beets harvested young for maximum sweetness and tenderness. Great for juicing or roasting, and a staple in the vegan food scene downtown.

products.name: Microgreen Mix
products.description: A spicy, nutrient-dense blend of beet, radish, and mustard microgreens. Perfect on sandwiches or as a garnish for the city’s trendiest brunches.

products.name: Pickled Beet Slices
products.description: Tangy, sweet, and earthy—these pickled beets are made with heritage varieties and a signature blend of spices. The perfect side for sandwiches or salads.

name: Lazy Goat Creamery
description: On a gentle hillside in northern California, Lazy Goat Creamery is a small, organic farm run by the eccentric but lovable Henson family. Famous for their friendly goats and experimental cheese flavors, they prioritize animal welfare and environmental stewardship.

products.name: Classic Goat Cheese Log
products.description: Smooth, tangy goat cheese—spreadable and ideal for crackers, bagels, or pasta. Made with milk from their pampered herd.

products.name: Herb & Garlic Chèvre
products.description: A creamy goat cheese infused with fresh garden herbs and a hint of garlic. Beloved by local chefs and a hit at wine tastings.

name: Maple & Mirth Family Farm
description: Nestled in Vermont’s rolling hills, Maple & Mirth is a fourth-generation family farm specializing in artisanal maple syrup and heritage apple orchards. With a passion for sustainable forestry and pollinator-friendly practices, the O’Connor family combines old-school sap collecting with modern organic techniques. Their philosophy: farm with a smile, share sweetness with the world.

products.name: Golden Dawn Maple Syrup
products.description: A rich, amber maple syrup tapped at the peak of spring. Its deep caramel flavor graces pancakes, oatmeal, and morning coffee. Each batch is boiled over wood fires in a tradition passed down for over a century.

products.name: Apple Blossom Cider
products.description: Lightly sparkling cider made from a blend of heritage apples, pressed and fermented on site. Features crisp tartness and a floral aroma. Perfect for autumn evenings or festive gatherings.

products.name: Maple Sugar Candy
products.description: Delicate, melt-in-your-mouth confections crafted from pure maple syrup. Shaped like maple leaves, these are a sweet reminder of Vermont’s forests. Caution: may induce nostalgia for childhood field trips.

products.name: Homestead Apple Butter
products.description: A slow-cooked spread blending fragrant apples and warm spices, finished with a hint of maple syrup. Great for toast, baking, or sneaking by the spoonful from the jar.

name: Sun & Soil Organic Veggie Collective
description: A worker-owned cooperative in California’s Central Valley, Sun & Soil grows a riot of organic vegetables with a focus on unusual heirloom varieties. Known for their regenerative farming, cover cropping, and whimsical field scarecrows, they supply local markets and innovative farm-to-table restaurants.

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Medley
products.description: A crunchy, colorful mix of purple, yellow, and orange heirloom carrots. Naturally sweet and perfect for roasting, snacking, or impressing at dinner parties. Farm favorite for lunchbox crunch.

products.name: Spicy Green Garlic Scapes
products.description: Spring’s fleeting treat—garlic scapes picked at their most tender, with a bright, spicy-garlicky flavor. Great grilled or blitzed into pesto. Rumored to keep vampires and bland food far away.

products.name: Heritage Tomato Basket
products.description: A lush selection of oddball tomatoes: green zebras, brandywines, and midnight purples. Bursting with sweetness and acidity, destined for salads or the world’s fanciest BLT.

products.name: Celery Crunch Stalks
products.description: Super-crisp celery stalks selected for maximum snap. Ideal for juicing, dipping, or as a peanut butter vehicle (no ants included).

name: Nutty by Nature Orchards
description: Located in Oregon’s Willamette Valley, Nutty by Nature is a mid-sized orchard focusing on sustainable tree nut production—especially hazelnuts and walnuts. The Nutty team champions cover-cropping, owl-friendly pest control, and the annual ‘Squirrel Awareness Festival.’

products.name: Hazel’s Secret Spread
products.description: A creamy, chocolate-hazelnut spread with a cult following among toast lovers. Smooth, sweet, and perfect for indulgent breakfasts or sneaky midnight snacks.

products.name: Walnut Crunch Granola
products.description: Toasty oats, Oregon walnuts, and a hint of maple syrup. This crunchy granola is a breakfast upgrade and doubles as a trail snack. Warning: highly addictive.

products.name: Orchard Hazelnuts (Whole, Roasted)
products.description: Slow-roasted hazelnuts in the shell, perfect for cracking open at family gatherings or holiday parties. Rich, buttery flavor with a hint of woodsmoke from the orchard's own ovens.

name: Green Pastures Aquaponics Farm
description: Green Pastures is a high-tech urban farm in Detroit, transforming old warehouses into lush aquaponics systems. They produce ultra-fresh leafy greens and raise tilapia, all with minimal water use and zero pesticides. Their mission: healthy food, healthy city, happy fish.

products.name: Detroiter Butter Lettuce
products.description: Soft, buttery leaves grown in mineral-rich aquaponics beds. Exceptionally tender and mild—ideal for gourmet salads, sandwiches, or lettuce wraps. Grown above a school of very content tilapia.

products.name: Rooftop Basil Bunches
products.description: Aromatic Genovese basil, snipped fresh daily. Adds punch to pesto, pasta, and tomato salads. Grown under LED lights powered by Detroit’s own sun (and the electric grid).

products.name: Aquaponic Tilapia Fillets
products.description: Mild, flaky tilapia raised in pristine, recirculated water. Sustainably farmed and perfect for grilling or tacos. Fun fact: the fish help fertilize the greens!

name: Buckaroo Buckwheat Ranch
description: Sprawled across the windy plains of North Dakota, this quirky family-run ranch specializes in buckwheat and heritage grains. The Fergusons are proud of their gluten-free pancake mixes and host an annual 'Buckwheat Hoedown' with live fiddling.

products.name: Buckaroo Pancake Mix
products.description: Light and fluffy, these pancakes are made from whole buckwheat flour, offering a nutty flavor and hearty texture—perfect for a cowboy breakfast. Gluten-free but not flavor-free!

products.name: Buckwheat Honey
products.description: Produced by the ranch’s own bees, this dark, robust honey has a malty, earthy depth. Excellent for baking, tea, or as a bold toast topper. Limited edition at each harvest.

products.name: Buckwheat Groats (Whole Grain)
products.description: Whole hulled buckwheat kernels, ready for cooking into hearty pilafs or porridge. Loved by health foodies and gluten-free bakers alike.

name: Highland Herd Creamery
description: Nestled in the rolling hills of Vermont, Highland Herd Creamery is a third-generation family dairy farm focused on artisanal cheeses and yogurts. With a small herd of happy, pasture-raised cows and a handful of mischievous goats, the farm prides itself on sustainable practices, humane animal care, and crafting dairy products the old-fashioned way. Their philosophy: real milk, real flavor, real community.

products.name: Vermont Aged Cheddar
products.description: A sharp, crumbly cheddar aged for over a year in our cool stone cellar, developing nutty undertones and a crystalline texture. Perfect for snacking or melting in grilled cheese sandwiches.

products.name: Highland Cream Yogurt
products.description: Thick, creamy yogurt made from our pasture-raised cow's milk. Great with granola or fruit, and tangy enough to substitute for sour cream.

products.name: Goat's Milk Feta Crumble
products.description: Brined, tangy feta made from our herd of free-roaming goats. Crumbles beautifully over salads or roasted veggies.

products.name: Maple Swirl Cream Cheese
products.description: Silky cream cheese blended with local Vermont maple syrup, perfect on bagels or as a decadent dip for apple slices.

name: The Spicy Turnip Co-op
description: Founded by a group of young urban farmers in Portland, Oregon, The Spicy Turnip Co-op specializes in heirloom root vegetables and spicy specialty crops. Fiercely dedicated to organic principles and community food security, they rotate unusual crops, host urban farm tours, and supply local restaurants with unique flavors.

products.name: Firecracker Radishes
products.description: Peppery, crunchy radishes with a vibrant fuchsia color. Adds zing to salads or sandwiches, and makes a spicy quick pickle.

products.name: Purple Haze Carrots
products.description: Deep purple carrots with a sweet, earthy flavor and a hint of spice. Great roasted or raw; the color stays brilliant even after cooking.

products.name: Dragon Tongue Turnips
products.description: Rare heirloom turnips with violet streaks and a sharp, radish-like bite. Excellent roasted or thinly shaved on salads for a mustardy punch.

products.name: Chili Blaze Hot Peppers
products.description: Small, wrinkled red chilis with high heat and a smoky undertone. Ideal for homemade hot sauce or adding fire to stir-fries.

name: Feather & Flap Homestead
description: A quirky, free-range poultry farm in rural Tennessee, Feather & Flap is run by a mother-daughter team who believe chickens are family—sometimes literally. Their eggs are legendary at local markets, and their birds are pampered with classical music and organic feed. They also offer educational farm tours and backyard chicken starter kits.

products.name: Golden Yolker Eggs
products.description: Farm-fresh, pasture-raised eggs with deep golden yolks. Perfect for breakfast or baking; taste the sunshine in every bite.

products.name: Cloud Puff Angel Food Cake
products.description: A feathery light cake made with our freshest eggs—airy, sweet, and excellent with macerated berries or whipped cream.

products.name: Henhouse Mayo
products.description: Creamy homemade mayonnaise starring our signature eggs and a hint of Tennessee mustard seed. Spread it thick!

name: Sunset Orchard Collective
description: Stretching across the gentle slopes of eastern Washington, the Sunset Orchard Collective is a worker-owned cooperative that cultivates apples, cherries, and pears. With a focus on biodiversity and habitat restoration, their members plant pollinator strips and use integrated pest management for healthy, flavorful fruit.

products.name: Blushing Gala Apples
products.description: Crisp, juice-packed apples with a rose-pink hue and a honeyed finish. Ideal for snacking, pie-making, or juicing.

products.name: Starburst Cherries
products.description: Deep red cherries that burst with sweet-tart flavor. Hand-picked at dawn for maximum juiciness, they're a local summer favorite.

products.name: Honeydew Pear Preserves
products.description: A luscious, slow-cooked pear jam with hints of vanilla and cinnamon. Slather on scones, swirl into oatmeal, or gift to a friend.

products.name: Apple Blossom Cider
products.description: A lightly sparkling, small-batch cider pressed from a mix of heirloom apples. Floral aroma with a dry, clean finish.

name: Happy Hooves Goat Ranch
description: Tucked away in the Texas Hill Country, Happy Hooves Goat Ranch is a small specialty farm raising Nigerian Dwarf goats for milk, cheese, and soap. Known for their playful goats and family-friendly tours, they also support local 4-H clubs and donate surplus cheese to area food banks. Their motto: "Goats make everything better!"

products.name: Sunshine Chevre Spread
products.description: A creamy, tangy goat cheese spread with a hint of lemon zest, perfect on crackers or as a pasta sauce base.

products.name: Goat Milk Caramel (Cajeta)
products.description: Traditional Mexican-style caramel sauce made by slowly simmering fresh goat's milk and sugar until it turns golden and rich. Drizzle over ice cream or pancakes.

products.name: Lavender Dream Goat Milk Soap
products.description: Luxurious, hand-poured soap crafted with farm-fresh goat milk and calming lavender oil. Gentle on skin, but not for those with milk sensitivity.

name: Blue Willow Aquafarm
description: Blue Willow Aquafarm is a family-run fish and aquatic produce farm nestled on the banks of the Willamette River in Oregon. Founded by the Lin family in 1998, the farm focuses on sustainable aquaculture, raising both freshwater and saltwater fish along with specialty water plants. Their philosophy is rooted in environmental stewardship and providing local chefs with the freshest catch possible, cultivated in harmony with the natural ecosystem.

products.name: Willamette Silver Trout Filets
products.description: Rich, buttery trout filets sustainably raised in crystal-clear waters. These filets are prized for their delicate flavor and firm texture, perfect for pan-searing or grilling. A favorite among local restaurants for their freshness.

products.name: Lemongrass-Infused Branzino
products.description: Whole branzino marinated and infused with organic lemongrass from the farm’s herb beds. Mild, slightly sweet flesh with a citrusy aroma, perfect for baking or roasting whole.

products.name: Watercress Bunches
products.description: Vibrant, peppery watercress grown in nutrient-rich ponds. Adds a fresh bite to salads and sandwiches and is a favorite in spring soups. Packed with vitamins and antioxidants.

name: Rolling Acres Grain Collective
description: Rolling Acres Grain Collective is a midwestern farmer-owned cooperative located outside Wichita, Kansas. Established in 1972, the collective brings together several local farming families to grow, mill, and market a variety of heritage grains. Their focus is on crop diversity, soil health, and providing bakers with robust, flavorful grains that recall the region’s agricultural roots.

products.name: Prairie Gold Wheat Flour
products.description: Stone-milled hard red wheat flour with a nutty, robust flavor. Ideal for artisanal breads and rustic pastries, this flour is sought after by local bakeries for its protein content and traditional taste.

products.name: Barley Malt Syrup
products.description: Thick, golden syrup extracted from sprouted barley. Adds a deep, malty sweetness to breads, bagels, and homebrew. A staple in old-school baking and local microbreweries.

products.name: Buckwheat Pancake Mix
products.description: A hearty, gluten-free blend featuring locally grown buckwheat. Earthy and nutty, these pancakes are a weekend favorite. Despite the name, no wheat—just pure buckwheat goodness!

name: Sunny Patch Veggies
description: Sunny Patch Veggies is a small, certified organic market garden on the outskirts of Asheville, North Carolina. Run by a pair of energetic siblings, this farm specializes in unusual heirloom vegetables, edible flowers, and vibrant salad greens. Their mission is to bring color, flavor, and biodiversity to local tables while minimizing environmental impact.

products.name: Rainbow Carrot Medley
products.description: A crunchy mix of purple, orange, and yellow heirloom carrots, each with their own distinct flavor. Sweet, earthy, and beautiful on any crudité platter. Grown chemical-free for the purest taste.

products.name: Spicy Microgreen Salad Mix
products.description: A lively blend of mustard greens, radish shoots, and arugula microgreens. Peppery, zesty, and packed with nutrients—perfect as a salad base or sandwich topping.

products.name: Edible Flower Bouquet
products.description: A fragrant, colorful mix of nasturtiums, pansies, and calendula. These blossoms add a visual and flavor pop to cakes, salads, and cocktails. Harvested fresh every morning.
